Two commemorative collections have approved exceptions: **Little Frights** and **Troves After Dark** explorers each contribute **150 stamina**, even though their edition size would normally fall in the 75-stamina band.

### How to Bank Troves and Build Progress

**Banking is the primary way to increase your Upland Progression level at launch.** Banking means permanently depositing Troves into the **Trove Vault** to meet progression requirements and work toward rewards.

- **Open your Trove Wallet** and choose a Trove you have collected.
- **Review its available banking tier.** Bronze and Silver are available in this first release, and the required quantity can vary by Trove.
- **Use the bank action when you hold enough copies.** The banking option becomes available when your inventory meets the requirement.
- **Confirm the permanent deposit.** Banked Troves cannot be withdrawn, returned to spendable inventory, or used in recipes later. That final step matters. A Trove in your inventory remains available for future recipes and other uses as those systems arrive. A Trove placed in the Vault becomes part of your permanent banking achievement instead.

*Banking interface preview*

Each Trove has its own banked tier, while your profile has an **overall Upland Progression level**. Banking Troves helps move that overall level forward. Your profile shows the next milestone and its available reward, giving you a clear goal without requiring you to memorize the whole progression path.

*Your profile shows your Upland Progression level and the next milestone.*

The** beta** begins strictly with Troves as the progression requirement. **Additional types of requirements** may be introduced later after the team has **real usage data**. The opening levels are designed to teach the collection and banking loop, so their pace and rewards **should not be treated as the final depth of progression**.

### Crafting: What Comes Next

Crafting is an important part of the larger Troves system, but **it is not available on launch day**. Here is how the loop will work as recipes roll out:

- **Discover a Trove.** The first discovery reveals recipes that consume that Trove.
- **Collect the ingredients.** A recipe becomes ready when you hold its required Troves.
- **Go to the Service Structure where the recipe is available.** Recipes are accessed on the Service Structure itself, not from a generic property menu.
- **Fulfill the recipe.** Crafting consumes the listed ingredients and grants the recipe’s stated result. Recipes can also provide additional bonus rewards.
- **Explore deeper combinations.** Some crafted Troves can become ingredients in later recipes, creating higher-level paths over time. Players select a recipe, not its bonus roll. The stated result provides the recipe’s default outcome, while any additional rewards can vary. This lets crafting have surprises without turning the basic result into a completely unknown outcome.

### What the Phased Beta Builds Toward

### What the Phased Beta Builds Toward

The launch set of 189 collectible Troves is **the first batch**, not the full catalog. Across the rollout, the team is preparing **over 500 Troves and a much deeper recipe system**. New Troves, recipes, and banking tiers will arrive in regular batches over the coming weeks, **allowing the system to grow** without asking players to understand every layer at once.

The beta also gives the team room to **tune collection activity**, **reward pacing**, **progression requirements**, and** overall balance**. Early mechanics and rewards can change as real play reveals what is working and what needs adjustment. Later systems, including broader plant interactions, automation, and farming, are part of the future direction rather than today’s first release.

For now, the best way to begin is simple: move your Block Explorer, try different Service Structures and plants, fill your wallet, compare discoveries with other players, and **choose carefully **before banking anything permanently.

### Start Exploring Today

What will your first Trove be? Which discoveries will you preserve in your Vault, and which will you hold for the recipes still to come?

Troves are going live today. [Bring back a friend](https://playupland.com/Medium1) who has been waiting for a fresh reason to explore, invite someone new to discover their first neighborhood, and share what you find. This next part of Upland will be more fun when the community uncovers it together.

# Troves Launch Weekend: Collect, Bank, and Compete

October 22, 2026

***Editor’s note**: Trove Bankers leaderboard scoring has been updated to recognize higher banking tiers. Each eligible Trove type earns 1 point at Bronze or 3 points at Silver, with only its highest tier counting. Upgrading from Bronze to Silver adds 2 points to your score. Trove Collectors scoring and all announced prizes remain unchanged.*

*
*

Troves are **now live** in Upland, and we’re celebrating with a first-weekend challenge:** collect Troves, bank Troves, and compete for up to 1.75 million UPX in prizes**. From launch through **Monday, October 26 at 9:00 a.m. PT**, explore structures and plants, build your collection, and make your first permanent deposits. Bring a returning friend or a first-time player, compare finds, and make the first Troves weekend one to remember.

Then, **join the Upland team next Tuesday **for Troves: The Bigger Picture, a live conversation with Upland Co-Founder Idan Zuckerman about** why Troves are a major step for Upland**, what we’re learning from the launch, and **what’s coming next**. Get hands-on this weekend, then join us to explore where Troves will take Upland.

[See the live stream here](https://www.youtube.com/live/FVsi4UQPNTo).

### Two Ways to Compete

There is no entry form or screenshot submission. Eligible game activity during the competition window counts automatically.

- **Trove Collectors:** Ranked by the total number of individual Troves collected from structures and plants during the competition. Every eligible Trove, including duplicates, counts as one. Trove Dust, opening inventory, promotional or administrative grants, quiz rewards, and purchased packs do not count. Banking never reduces your Collector score: it measures earned collection quantity, not what remains in your inventory.
- **Trove Bankers:** Trove Bankers: Climb the leaderboard by banking different Troves and upgrading them to Silver. Each Bronze-banked Trove type earns 1 point, while each Silver-banked Trove type earns 3 points. Only your highest tier for each Trove type counts, so upgrading from Bronze to Silver adds 2 points to your score You can compete on **both leaderboards**, earn ranked prizes on both, and collect both leaderboard badges if you finish in the top 25 on each.

### Prizes for Each Leaderboard

The following UPX ladder applies **separately to Trove Collectors and Trove Bankers**:

- **1st:** 100,000 UPX
- **2nd:** 75,000 UPX
- **3rd:** 50,000 UPX
- **4th–10th:** 25,000 UPX each
- **11th–25th:** 15,000 UPX each Every top-25 finisher also earns that leaderboard’s badge. All top-25 Collectors receive the same **Troves Launch Weekend: Collector****badge**, and all top-25 Bankers receive the same **Troves Launch Weekend: Banker****badge**. There is one badge for each leaderboard, not a different badge for each placement.

### Participation Draw

You do not need a top-25 finish to have a chance at UPX. Up to **50 qualifying players** who do not receive a ranked top-25 prize on either leaderboard will be selected at random, without replacement, to receive **10,000 UPX each**.

### Participation Draw

You do not need a top-25 finish to have a chance at UPX. Up to **50 qualifying players** who do not receive a ranked top-25 prize on either leaderboard will be selected at random, without replacement, to receive **10,000 UPX each**.

To earn one entry in the participation draw, complete both requirements during the competition:

- Collect at least **10 eligible non-Dust Troves on each of two different PT calendar dates**. Collection quantities count, not ten separate collection attempts, and the same source exclusions used for the Trove Collectors leaderboard apply.
- Bank enough eligible Troves to reach **Bronze on at least three distinct eligible Trove types** during the event. Each qualifying player receives **one entry**, no matter how far beyond the requirements they go. Players receiving a top-25 prize on either leaderboard are excluded from the draw. If fewer than 50 eligible non-ranked players qualify, each qualifying player receives 2,000 UPX; unused prize allocations will not be increased or redistributed. The participation draw does not award a badge.

### How Ties Are Settled

For the Trove Collectors leaderboard, a tie goes first to the player who collected more distinct eligible Trove types. For the Trove Bankers leaderboard, a tie goes first to the player who banked more distinct eligible Trove types during the competition. If players are still exactly tied, their order will be decided by a random draw.

### Start Exploring

The first Troves weekend begins now and ends on **Monday, October 26 at 9:00 a.m. PT**. Collect what you can, decide what belongs in your Vault forever, and see how high you can climb on both leaderboards.

Share the challenge with your friends, help each other discover new Troves, and bring your neighborhood into the competition. We cannot wait to see what you collect, what you bank, and who rises to the top. **See you in Upland!**

# UGC Submission Update: Faster Approvals Are on the Way

July 24, 2026

*​**Editor’s Note:** This post has been updated to clarify that the historical 8–12 week approval timeline reflected normal operating conditions. The current backlog extends beyond that standard, and our goal with the new system is not only to catch up, but to ultimately reduce approvals to under one week.*​

Player-created content is a huge part of Upland’s future, and we’re excited to share an important update on UGC submissions.

Our developers have finished building a brand-new** automated approval system **designed specifically for **Upland’s unique UGC pipeline**. This is a custom solution built entirely from scratch and has now **entered its testing phase**.

We’ve already processed and released our** first batch of Map Assets** using this new system and are continuing to fine-tune it as testing progresses. As our confidence in the system grows, we’ll begin moving through submissions at a **much faster pace**.

You should expect to see **additional batches **of approved Map Assets rolling out over the coming weeks. Because the system is **still being tested**, you may occasionally notice issues or inconsistencies. If you do, please let us know so we can investigate and** improve the system**.

If testing continues to go well, we expect to be fully caught up on the current submission backlog **by Harvest Season**. Once we’re caught up, our focus will shift to **further refining and optimizing** the approval process.

Under normal operating conditions, UGC approvals have** historically taken approximately 8–12 weeks**. The current backlog extends beyond that standard, but as this new system ramps up, our goal is not simply to return to the old timeline. We are working toward **reducing submission-to-approval time to under one week**.

**There’s still work ahead**, but we’re excited that this new system is already live, processing submissions, and moving us toward a much faster future for UGC creators.

# Uppie Quests Are Coming: Turn Troves Into New Friends

September 08, 2026

Troves are about to unlock much more than collecting.

After **Troves, Trove Banking, and Upland Progression** launch, the next major piece of Upland’s connected gameplay loop will arrive: **Uppie Quests**.

**Uppie Quests** will send players across the map to gather Troves, complete recipes, and earn the special **Friend Request Troves** needed to befriend new Uppies. They will also give developed properties, **Residents**, assigned Uppies, plants, and service structures **more ways to matter** together.

The loop is taking shape: **develop **properties**, collect **Troves**, choose **what to craft or bank**, complete** Uppie Quests**, **and **befriend **more Uppies who cansupport your properties and** Trove strategy.**

**Troves arrive first. Uppie Quests follow.** Here is your first look at how the systems connect.

### Find Uppie Quests Across the Map

As you explore Upland, you will be able to discover properties offering **Uppie Quests**. When an Uppie Card appears above a property, a quest is waiting there.

While property assignment began with **Level 3 and higher Uppies**, the Uppie Quest rollout is planned to open property assignment to **Uppies across all levels**.

To be eligible to spawn an **Uppie Quest, a property must have both Residents and an assigned Uppie**. Uppies of **any level** can fulfill the Uppie requirement, from Level 1 all the way up. Having both Residents and an assigned Uppie makes a property eligible to spawn quests, although an eligible property will not necessarily have a quest available at all times.

All assigned Uppies can participate in the Uppie Quest system. The difference is what else they can do on a property. For **Level 1 and Level 2 Uppies**, Uppie Quest participation will be their only property utility. Higher-level Uppies can also participate in Uppie Quests while retaining their additional abilities, such as caring for plants and, for eligible Uppies, and eventually automatically collecting Troves.

There will also be benefits for property owners when other players select an **Uppie Quest** from their property. We’ll share more about how those benefits work, along with additional details on quest availability, as we get closer to launch.

### From Trove Hunting to Uppie Questing

Every Uppie Quest is a mission built around a request from an Uppie.

Maybe an Uppie is craving breakfast and asks you to bring back a **croissant and coffee**. Gather the requested Troves, turn them in to complete the Uppie Quest, and see what you receive.

Completing an Uppie Quest gives you a **chance to receive a Friend Request Trove**, but it isn’t guaranteed. You may receive other items instead, making each completed quest a chance to earn the Friend Request Troves you’ll need to befriend new Uppies.

These special Troves are one of the key ingredients required to befriend new Uppies, and **Uppie Quests will be the primary way to earn them**.

Completing an Uppie Quest gives you a **chance to receive a Friend Request Trove**, but it isn’t guaranteed. You may receive other items instead, making each completed quest a chance to earn the Friend Request Troves you’ll need to befriend new Uppies.

These special Troves are one of the key ingredients required to befriend new Uppies, and **Uppie Quests will be the primary way to earn them**.

This is where the larger Trove system becomes even more strategic. As previously announced, Troves can serve different purposes across Upland:

- Use Troves in **crafting recipes and Uppie Quests**.
- Exchange eligible Troves for items or rewards when opportunities are available.
- Permanently bank selected Troves in your **Trove Vault** to advance Trove Banking levels and contribute to **Upland Progression**. Banked Troves cannot be withdrawn or used elsewhere, so collecting is only the beginning. **Players will decide** what to spend, what to craft with, and what to preserve permanently as part of their Upland history.

### Properties, Plants, Service Structures, and Uppies Feed the Loop

**Uppie Quests** do not sit beside Troves as a separate feature. They give the Troves you collect another purpose while strengthening the systems that help produce them.

As previously announced:

- **Healthy plants** can improve the potential for more Trove drops and rarer Troves.
- **Level 3 and higher Uppies** assigned to properties can care for plants when players keep them fed.
- **Level 5 and higher Uppies** are planned to automatically collect Troves from plants on assigned properties.
- **Level 5 and higher Uppies** can also be employed at eligible service structures, where they contribute to structure levels and can automate Trove collection.
- **Higher service-structure levels** can unlock better Trove drops from recipes.
- **Automated collection** by Uppies uses a separate daily limit from a player’s personal collection cap, allowing active play and Uppie automation to work together. That creates a **connected cycle**: develop properties and service structures, keep plants healthy, put Uppies to work, collect more useful Troves, complete more recipes and quests, and earn the **Friend Request Troves** needed to grow your Uppie collection.

### Three Quests at a Time

Players can maintain up to **three active Uppie Quests** at once.

Once all three quest slots are occupied, you will need to complete or dismiss an active quest **before accepting another**. If you discover a quest you would rather pursue, you can dismiss one to make room.

Some quests may also be time-limited, giving you a set window to gather the required Troves and complete the recipe.

**Choose carefully**. The quest you take, the Troves it requires, and the Friend Request Trove it rewards can all shape what you pursue next.

### Friend Request Troves and Befriending Uppies

Completing **Uppie Quests** rewards **Friend Request Troves**, with multiple levels available.

### Friend Request Troves and Befriending Uppies

Completing **Uppie Quests** rewards **Friend Request Troves**, with multiple levels available.

Higher-level **Friend Request Troves** can help you befriend higher-level Uppies, but earning them will require more demanding quests. Lower-level quests may use simpler recipes and more common Troves. Higher-level quests can require more complex recipes and potentially rarer Troves.

When it is time to befriend an Uppie, a befriending recipe can call for a combination of inputs, including:

- **Friend Request Troves**
- Other Troves
- UPX
- Sparklet Provide the required inputs, complete the recipe, and a newly befriended Uppie can join your collection.

That makes **Friend Request Troves** the bridge between the Troves you gather today and the Uppies you hope to meet tomorrow.

Uppies across all levels can potentially become available to befriend when the required Uppies are available in **Merge inventory**. That means befriending recipes will not always be available on demand.

Availability may change over time. Some recipes could appear during specific parts of a season, be announced in advance, remain available for longer periods, or become temporarily unavailable until inventory is replenished.

Your **Friend Request Troves** can prepare you for the opportunity. **Merge inventory** determines which friendships can be forged at that moment.

We will share more about befriending availability as the system rolls out.

### Why Build a Bigger Uppie Collection?

Uppies are becoming **active participants** in Upland’s property and Trove economy.

They can be **assigned** to properties. Eligible Uppies can **care for plants**. Higher-level Uppies are planned to **collect Troves** automatically from properties and service structures. Employed Uppies can help **level up** eligible service structures. Uppies can be traded, offer quests, and become **new friends** through the befriending system.

And there is more personality on the way. Uppies are planned to appear in **3D**, including on the map, and some may exist as truly unique one-of-one Uppies, similar to the **Dragon Mama Uppie** previously previewed.

Every new Uppie can **expand how you develop properties**, pursue Troves, complete quests, and express your place in Upland.

### Troves First. Uppie Quests Next.

Troves establish the foundation: collect across Upland, craft with what you find, permanently bank what you want to preserve, build your **Trove Vault**, and advance your **Upland Progression**.

**Uppie Quests** build on that foundation by turning Troves into missions, recipes, **Friend Request Troves**, and eventually new Uppies. Those Uppies can then return value to properties, plants, service structures, and future quests.

This is the connected Upland taking shape, with properties at the center and more of what you own, build, collect, and develop working together.

**Find the quests. Gather the Troves. Complete the recipes. Befriend the Uppies. Put them to work.**

# Uppie Quests Are Next: The Path to New Uppie Friends

November 10, 2026

​***Editor’s Note:**** We’ve clarified that the Uppie Research Lab will support befriending lower-level Uppies, while the Uppie Research Center will support higher-level Uppies. More details on the specific Uppie levels, recipes, and mechanics will be shared when Uppie Quests launch.*​

You have been exploring neighborhoods, collecting Troves, and discovering what you can craft. Next comes a new reason to head back out: **an Uppie with a request**, a quest to complete, and the** chance to befriend** a new character for your collection.

Troves 1.0 is fully launched, and **Uppie Quests are next**. Troves players gather will be useful in missions, **Friend Request Troves**, and opportunities to befriend new **Uppies**.

Starting now, the **Uppie Research Lab** and **Uppie Research Center** will become **permanently available **as public service structures. These are the **future locations for Uppie befriending recipes**, giving neighborhood builders a chance to** prepare for the next chapter** before quests and befriending arrive in a later update.

The Uppie Research Lab will be used to befriend lower-level Uppies, while the larger Uppie Research Center will be used to befriend higher-level Uppies.

How Uppie Quests Will Work

As players explore Upland, [a quest card](https://www.upland.me/events/uppie-quests-are-coming-turn-troves-into-new-friends) above an eligible property will signal that an Uppie has a request. **Properties with both Residents and an assigned Uppie **are planned to be eligible to offer quests, with **Uppies across all levels **able to participate. That gives developed properties and neighborhood activity a new reason to matter.

Accept a quest, **gather or craft** the requested Troves, and fulfill the request. One mission might feature an Uppie looking for breakfast, sending you out to find a croissant and coffee. Other requests can point toward different ingredients, recipes, and parts of the map. Players will be able to keep **up to three quests active at once**.

Completing a quest will give players a **chance to receive a Friend Request Trove**. That special Trove can become one ingredient in a befriending recipe at a Research structure. Combine the required inputs, complete the recipe, and a new Uppie can join your collection.

### Why You Will Want More Uppies

Uppies bring **personality **to a collection, but their role is becoming much more practical. Uppies of every level are planned to **take part in quests**. For Level 1 and Level 2 Uppies, quest participation is planned as their property utility. Level 3 and higher Uppies can also take part while retaining eligible roles such as **caring for plants when assigned.**

The longer-term vision goes further. In future updates, eligible Uppies are planned to **work at Service Structures**, **automatically collecting and crafting specific Troves**. That employment and **automation** will help players pursue collection, crafting, and progression goals beyond what is practical to handle manually. These systems will arrive in later updates and will not activate when the Research structures enter the store.

Collectors who want the complete lineup can grab the **Uppie Research Value Pack**, which includes The Uppie Research Lab and the Uppie Research Center for **$12**. That is **20% off regular pricing**!

The This structure will enable befriending higher level Uppies preparing builders for the moment when collected Troves can help bring new Uppies into their world. **Uppie Research Center** is a large public service structure that gives developed districts a more substantial home for future befriending recipes. *(Public Service, 37 Service Units)*

The next adventure begins when an Uppie asks for help and sends you back across Upland with a purpose. Each completed request can bring you closer to a new character for your collection and, over time, a more active role for Uppies throughout properties and Service Structures.

# We’ve Updated How We Email You

November 19, 2026

Click below to update your preferences.

We’ve changed the service that sends Upland email, and organized our messages into five subscription groups you can turn on or off. You get more control over what lands in your inbox, and the mail you want has a better chance of getting there.

Purchase receipts, security alerts, and account emails always stay on, whatever you choose. The new groups are only for the optional mail, so you can pick what fits how you play.

Here’s a look at the new groups, the two addresses to save, and how to set your preferences.

### The New Subscription Groups

You don’t have to take all of them. Choose the ones you want and leave the rest off.

- **Upland Recap.** Drops most weeks, with top strategic plays, community highlights, and a short overview of announcements you might have missed.
- **Game News & Releases.** Be the first to find out when new real-world cities launch on the map, new features go live, and gameplay guides drop. Sent around important release dates.
- **Events & Competitions.** Treasure Hunts, Troves, Racing, and more. Real-time alerts for live tournaments, global leaderboards, and in-game prize pools, sent during active challenges.
- **Just for You.** Picks based on how you play: custom milestones, deals, and strategy tips tuned to you. About once a month.
- **Style Shop.** Official apparel and gear drops, limited-edition merch, and early access to store discounts. Occasionally.

### Add These Two Addresses to Your Contacts

Upland email now comes from two addresses:

- **[[email protected]](https://www.upland.me/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)** for news, updates, and the groups above
- **[[email protected]](https://www.upland.me/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)** for account email like purchase receipts and password resets Please add both to your contacts or your safe senders list. Inbox filters often treat a new sending address as unfamiliar, even when the mail is from us. Saving both helps your receipts, password resets, and other account email reach your inbox instead of spam or junk.

- **Gmail.** Open [Google Contacts](https://contacts.google.com/), create a contact for each address, and save. If a message from us is in Spam, open it and choose Not spam.
- **Outlook.** Go to Settings, then Mail, then Junk email. Under Safe senders and domains, add each address and save.
- **Apple Mail and iCloud.** Add both addresses to your iCloud contacts. If a message is in Junk, move it to your Inbox.
- **Yahoo Mail.** Add both addresses to your contacts. If a message lands in Spam, select it and choose Not spam. If you use another email app, the same idea applies: save both addresses as contacts, and mark anything in junk as not junk.

# Your Block Explorers Are Ready for Their Next Adventure

October 12, 2026

***Editor’s note:** We’ve added a clarification that the images in this announcement are mockups and displayed values may change.*

​Your Block Explorers have been part of your Upland story: the characters you chose, the milestones you celebrated, and the collections you made your own. With **Troves on the way**, that collection is about to take on a new role. **Block Explorer stamina** will connect your explorers to **collecting and crafting**, giving the characters in your wallet a **bigger part to pla**y in your next adventure.

If you have a friend who has been waiting for more to do in Upland, **share this update** with them. Whether they are returning to a familiar neighborhood or discovering Upland for the first time, this is a moment to **get ready together**.

In our [earlier Block Explorer utility announcement](https://www.upland.me/events/developer-update-block-explorer-utility-structure-footprints), we introduced the direction. Now, let’s get into **how stamina will work** when Troves arrive, what you will be able to see in your wallet, and how to prepare your collection.

### Your Collection, Ready to Explore

**Stamina is the capacity your Block Explorers bring to Trove gameplay.** Collecting Troves across the map will use stamina. As you play, your available global stamina will decrease. **Receiving Trove Dust also uses stamina**, so a collection that yields dust still counts toward that activity.

Each Block Explorer contributes stamina toward your **global total**. Rarity helps determine that contribution, making the collection you hold in your wallet more meaningful in everyday play.

The Block Explorers you hold in your wallet contribute to one **global stamina total**. Your available global stamina determines how much you can collect at any given time. You do not need to switch between explorers to use it: your collection contributes to a shared pool, giving the explorers you own a **direct role in how much you can do**.

Every player starts with a baseline of **100 stamina per day**, giving everyone the ability to participate in Trove collecting. The Block Explorers you own add additional stamina capacity to your global pool, allowing you to collect more as your collection grows.

**These initial stamina values are a starting point.** We’ll be monitoring gameplay and player activity after launch and making adjustments over time to ensure the system remains balanced, rewarding, and fun for everyone.

​​*All images shown are mockups for illustrative purposes. Final stamina values and other displayed numbers are subject to change.*

### A Fresh Start Every Day

**Stamina refills every 6 hours starting at 5 PM PT ***(00:00 UTC)***.** This is a shared daily refill, rather than a separate countdown that begins whenever you use an explorer.

​​*All images shown are mockups for illustrative purposes. Final stamina values and other displayed numbers are subject to change.*

### A Fresh Start Every Day

**Stamina refills every 6 hours starting at 5 PM PT ***(00:00 UTC)***.** This is a shared daily refill, rather than a separate countdown that begins whenever you use an explorer.

Use some or all of your available stamina throughout the day, then return after the refill with your explorers replenished and ready to go again. The daily rhythm gives you a clear way to plan your collecting and crafting as you work toward your next goal.

### See What Your Explorers Can Do

You will be able to keep track of stamina without guessing:

- **Your profile and the top-left display:** check your overall Block Explorer stamina.
- **Asset Wallet → Block Explorers:** see each explorer’s maximum stamina and how much remains.
- **An individual Block Explorer’s full-screen view:** inspect its stamina alongside its asset details.

When inspecting **another player’s Block Explorer**, you will see its maximum stamina, not its current remaining stamina. That distinction matters when buying or swapping explorers: the displayed maximum tells you its capacity, not how much is available immediately.

**Transferring a Block Explorer does not refill its stamina.** If an explorer has already used all of its stamina, its new owner will need to wait for the next refill. Selling or swapping it does not create a fresh supply of stamina.

### Stamina Is the First Step. Modifiers Come Later.

We are **continuing our exploration of Block Explorer modifiers** as a future expansion of this system. Stamina establishes the foundation; modifiers are planned for a later stage and **will not be included in the initial stamina release when Troves arrive**.

Our goal is to give explorers **more individual character** in gameplay, with differences that go beyond how much stamina they bring. As shared in our initial announcement, we are exploring ideas such as **advantages **when collecting particular types of Troves, interactions with service structures, and benefits tied to** collecting a full series**.

**These are directions we are exploring, not finalized abilities or guaranteed bonuses.** Specific effects, eligible explorers, collection requirements, and timing will be shared as that work develops.

There is more we want to build here, and your feedback will help shape it. For now, the next step is **getting your Block Explorers ready **for their role in Troves.

### Grow Your Collection

**Now is the time to get your collection ready for Troves.** To help you prepare, and bring a little Halloween spirit along for the adventure, we’re introducing **Little Frights Halloween 2026**, alongside **Trove Core**, a new Terraformer celebrating the arrival of Troves in Upland. Whether you’re choosing your first collectible explorer or adding a new favorite to your wallet, these releases offer a chance to **grow your collection** ahead of stamina and the next chapter of collecting.

### Introducing Trove Core: A Terraformer for a New Chapter

**Trove Core celebrates the arrival of Troves in Upland.** With cream-colored armor, gold fittings, and a brilliant cyan energy core, this limited-edition Terraformer marks a new chapter of collecting and discovery.

With just **five mints**, Trove Core joins the ranks of Upland’s rarest Block Explorers, contributing **one of the highest stamina amounts in the game** to your collection’s global stamina pool.

And we’re thinking **even bigge**r for **Terraformers**. Source: https://upland-guide.com/2021/08/02/top-10-mistakes-made-in-upland-metaverse

## **1. Signing up without a referral link**

If you do put some money into the game to help you get started, Upland will give you an additional 50% bonus on your purchase - only if you signed up with a referral link. This bonus is applicable for $5 - $100 UPX purchase. For example, if your first in game purchase is $50, you will receive $75 worth of UPX. If you aren't interested in spending money that is OK as well, but know that by deciding to hold off on spending money, the 50% bonus is valid for your first purchase, and it must be done **before** you become an Uplander. You will still want to have a strategy before starting (see [mistake #10](http://think-long-term))

By not spending $5 (the minimum amount of money you can put into the game) you remain a visitor. As a visitor you are unable to sell a property until you reach uplander status (net worth of 10,000 UPX ($10). You are gifted a 4,500 UPX to start and you get some bonuses along the way, but not enough to immediately level up. You can put the time in to collect daily login bonuses and [complete starter missions](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/missions) to obtain Uplander status. Read here to find all the ways of [reaching Uplander status](https://upland-guide.com/becoming-an-uplander).

title: Top 10 Mistakes made in Upland : Upland Guide
text:
Document: Top 10 Mistakes made in Upland : Upland Guide
Source: https://upland-guide.com/2021/08/02/top-10-mistakes-made-in-upland-metaverse

## **2. Mistakingly Listing your property for a big loss**

Be extra careful when listing properties. People have created bots to look for under priced properties. **Always always always double check each digit before listing your property**. If your property sells within 30 seconds, you have probably made one of the following mistakes:

- You forgot a zero in your price. This means you listed it for sale 10X less than what you intended

- You did not realize your property is a valuable collection property. See [this page](https://upland-guide.com/property-card) to double check if your property is part of a collection.

- You listed the sale price thinking it was in USD but listed in UPX. Below you can see in the leftmost picture you are given the option to the list the property for UPX or USD. If you choose UPX, you are taken to the middle picture. The price you input is in UPX only. The two check boxes below the price are if you are accepting offers on the property. By unchecking the UPX button it does **not** mean you want to sell for USD. To sell for USD, you should see the 3rd picture, as you can clearly see the offer type in USD, and the value includes the '$' sign. Read more here about [how to sign up to sell properties for USD.](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions)

## ** 3A. Trying to mint a property that is not available**

Many people have found properties in cities that appear to be available to mint. In a city like Manhattan, where it has been sold out for months, finding an available property is too good to be true. If you click the property and see under the address "This property is not available", it means just that. Don't waste a visit trying to mint it, its not available.

## ** 4. Not setting maximum visitor fees**

This is a critical mistake if you insist on not investing money to become an Uplander. As a visitor, when you ask people to visit your profile, where the entire goal is to earn as much UPX per visit to help you reach Uplander status, you should set the fees to the maximum.

## ** 5. Not understanding the numbers**

It can be tempting to jump right in and buy your first few properties. Understand what you are buying. Don't be fooled by the size of the property. Not all properties of the same size are equal! Read about [understanding the property card here](https://upland-guide.com/property-card).

title: Top 10 Mistakes made in Upland : Upland Guide
text:
Document: Top 10 Mistakes made in Upland : Upland Guide
Source: https://upland-guide.com/2021/08/02/top-10-mistakes-made-in-upland-metaverse

## ** 6. Not taking advantage of FSA properties**

FSA stands for Fair Start Act. This allows new players (Visitors and Uplanders who have less than 100,000 UPX net worth) exclusivity on minting certain properties. These properties are typically more affordable, and can be found in almost all neighborhoods! You can find excellent properties if you take part in the release of a new city. [Read more about FSA properties here](https://upland-guide.com/fsa-properties). FSA properties are great for players looking to begin playing upland without investing a lot of money. If you are looking to invest, know that there are restrictions (see number 7 below) and you really won't be missing out on much by starting out with an initial investment of $100 or more)

title: Top 10 Mistakes made in Upland : Upland Guide
text:
Document: Top 10 Mistakes made in Upland : Upland Guide
Source: https://upland-guide.com/2021/08/02/top-10-mistakes-made-in-upland-metaverse

## ** 7. Not knowing about the FSA restrictions**

You may only sell (and list for sale) 2 FSA properties per calendar week (resets on 12AM Monday UST). You can only mint 3 FSA properties each day. If you are unable to sell a property for a very large markup, being stuck trying to flip FSA properties can be a very slow process for growing your net worth. It is recommended to not only purchase FSA properties. [Read more about FSA properties and all the restrictions here](https://upland-guide.com/fsa-properties).

## ** 8. Treasure hunting**

It might be tempting to try out all the features the game has to offer. For new players, beyond completing the treasure hunting mission, avoid treasure hunts. They require searching the city by use of sends (and paying visitor fees) in the hopes of finding a treasure of more UPX. Sending your block explorer to your own property is free of charge, so treasure hunts typically favor players who have many properties scattered around a city. Learning about treasure hunting is important and it is a great way to find spark. Its important to [read this page](https://upland-guide.com/top-5-things-to-understand-before-treasure-hunting) before beginning to hunt.

## ** 10. Spending $5 to get started without thinking long term**

If you did use the [referral code](https://r.upland.me/WhrG), spend some time thinking about how you want to play this game. $5 is a great way to get started, but you might soon realize that it is still difficult to grow with only a handful of properties. By making that $5 purchase, you miss out on an opportunity to gain a 50% bonus on a larger sum of money. The best starter value is to spend $50 as your first purchase. This will give you 75,000 UPX and a lot more room to purchase a more well rounded profile, while still enabling you to benefit from the ability to purchase FSA properties. In addition, if you use the referral code above **AND** spend $50 or more, you are entitled to another bonus from the Upland Guide! [Read more about that bonus here](https://upland-guide.com/referral-bonus). Note that in order to be eligible for these benefits, in addition to using our referral code, you must make your UPX purchase **as a visitor before becoming an Uplander.**

[Click here](https://upland-guide.com/top-mistakes-new-city-release) to read about the top mistakes to avoid when participating in a new city release.

Good luck in the Metaverse!

# Why Join Upland? : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/about/join-upland-metaverse
Metaverse, blockchain, NFTs, smart contracts. If these terms are new to you, you have come to the right place. Upland is a new type of game platform made possible thanks to the blockchain called "play and earn" gaming.

Have you ever wanted to own a piece of land in your favorite city? [Upland](https://upland.me) is a virtual property trading game based on real-world addresses. The base of the game allows people to buy, collect, sell and trade the land. True ownership is secured on the blockchain and rewards players with Upland's in-game currency UPX. In addition to owning land you can own and collect NFTs of your favorite NFL Players, or soccer players. Upland already has partnership with [FIFA](https://upland-guide.com/upland-legits-main/fifa-world-cup-qatar-2022)and the [NFLPA](https://upland-guide.com/upland-legits-nfl/getting-started-with-nfl-legits). You can't rebuild the world without the ability to construct buildings and own [cars](https://upland-guide.com/transportation/cars)either!

In Upland, [earnings can take many different forms](https://upland-guide.com/earning-in-upland), most intriguing being the ability to earn in USD! Whether you are a metaverse property realtor, collector of NFL player NFTs, a [spark](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/spark)construction worker, or a [metaventure](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures)business owner, new economies and jobs are being created within the metaverse. Digital creators are having new opportunities to monetize their creations in a way not previously possible prior to the existence of the blockchain.

"Play, Earn, Connect" is the vision of Upland. Having the land divided by cities and neighborhoods just like in the real world creates an opportunity for people to connect and work together to build a community, develop their neighborhood and stand out. Building a desirable community to live in can increase the value of your properties if you are able to create a demand for people to live there. Additional rewards will be provided to strong neighborhoods who succeed in creating a developed neighborhood that includes buildings, metaventures, and a thriving community.

Upland has a [licensing agreement with the NFL Players Association](http://upland-legits-nfl), enabling fans to "extend their real-life presence into the Upland metaverse and beyond. These new digital assets (NFTs) will enable fans to directly engage with the brands they love in an entirely new way!" You can collect [NFTs of your favorite players and teams](https://upland-guide.com/upland-legits-nfl), with the opportunity to get them digitally [autographed](https://upland-guide.com/upland-legits-nfl/upland-legits-nfl-types)by your favorite player!

Upland is an excellent way to get your feet wet in this new emerging technology. You don't need any previous knowledge or understanding of the blockchain or cryptocurrencies to have fun, and earn. If you aren't convinced that the Metaverse is the future, check out why [Mark Zuckerberg is turning Facebook into a Metaverse company](https://www.theverge.com/22588022/mark-zuckerberg-facebook-ceo-metaverse-interview). # Community : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/community
The three pillars of the Upland Metaverse are [play](https://upland-guide.com/entertainment), [earn](https://upland-guide.com/economy)and connect. As social animals, humans want to connect to each other, build and belong to communities. The Metaverse is no different. If you always wanted to live in Hollywood or Manhattan, Upland provides you with the opportunity to do so. You can find like minded players, connect and begin to develop your neighborhood. Players are even able to spawn [new neighborhood collections](https://upland-guide.com/community/neighborhood-ratings) by working together with their neighbors and developing their neighborhoods.

The most important part of connecting with others and being part of a community is having an identity. Having an identity is crucial for self-expression and defining individuality. It facilitates social interaction, shaping how a person is perceived by others and contributing to their opportunities and relationships. It also promotes mental health by providing a sense of self-worth and purpose, aiding in decision-making that aligns with values and beliefs. Through 3D avatars and block explorers, you are able to express yourself in Upland. [Learn more about that here.](https://upland-guide.com/community/3d-avatar-identity)

Players are able to connect in [cafes](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/upland-cafes), which are immersive 3D [metaventures](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures)where you can chat with friends and hold community events. Upland's City Center Plaza, located at 52 Grove St., San Francisco, where you can learn more about Upland, and enter the Community Corner where large scale events will be held. [Learn more about the City Center Plaza here.](https://youtu.be/tPlJZ2vRP1k)

You have the ability to define your Upland [permanent residence](https://upland-guide.com/community/governance-and-voting) and have [voting rights](https://upland-guide.com/community/governance-and-voting/how-to-vote) on important things that relate to your neighborhood and city. Unlike other Metaverses, Upland has created barriers to [travelling](https://upland-guide.com/transportation). Moving between cities takes time and costs you UPX. This will add further importance to the need to choose your permanent residence wisely. Just like in the real world, there will be players who won't frequently travel far from home and this will further strengthen the community aspect within Upland.

The Upland Guide also has a [community blog](https://upland-guide.com/updates) that you can read here.

# Trade & Earn : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/economy
-

🏪 Where Assets Are Traded

Upland Marketplace

Upland gives players two distinct ways to buy and sell assets — the Open Marketplace and player-owned Metaventure stores.

🔓 Open Marketplace

List & Buy Directly

Upland properties — along with any 3D assets placed on them — can be listed for sale by any player. Set your price in UPX or USD, and any player in the world can purchase it directly. It's the most accessible way to trade your portfolio.

**⚠️ Important Restrictions:** Depending on your in game status, and whether the propery is FSA status, you may encounter USD sale restrictions

[FSA Sale Restrictions](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/fsa-properties) [USD Sale Cooldown](https://upland-guide.com/upland-status)

🏗️ Metaventures

Player-Owned Storefronts

Metaventures are player-owned stores that specialize in specific types of assets — decor, cars, collectibles, and more. They offer a curated shopping experience and a powerful business opportunity for entrepreneurial Uplanders.

Players can list their items at any Metaventure for a commission

- Build your own Metaventure to sell your own products and earn on others'

- To buy: travel directly to the store, or own a property in the same city — then shop from anywhere

- Metaventures can develop their own brand reputation and loyal customers

[🏗️ Learn More About Metaventures →](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures)

💱 How Value Flows

The Upland Economy

Upland runs on four distinct currencies, each serving a different purpose. Understanding how they interact is the key to building a successful earning strategy.

[📖 How to Earn](https://upland-guide.com/earning-in-upland)

UPX

In-Game Currency

UPX is Upland's core in-game currency and the foundation of the entire economy. It can be purchased directly from the Upland store using real USD. UPX is used to travel to new cities and mint (purchase) unminted properties on the map. Items — including properties and 3D NFT assets — can be priced and sold for UPX on the open marketplace and in Metaventures.

[📖 How the UPX Economy Works →](https://upland-guide.com/economy/financial-pools)

USD

Real Money Earnings

Players can earn real US dollars by selling their Upland assets — either properties listed on the open marketplace or items sold through Metaventures. USD earnings represent the most direct path to real-world value from your Upland portfolio. To sell for USD, you must complete KYC (Know Your Customer) identity verification and meet eligibility requirements.

[✅ Complete KYC to Sell for USD →](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/earning-in-upland)

$SPARKLET

ERC-20 Token · World-Building Fuel

$SPARKLET is an ERC-20 fungible token that fuels all value creation in the Upland metaverse. It is the resource required for world-building, joint community projects, no-code NFT minting, and manufacturing 3D map NFTs such as cars, decor items, and more. Unlike UPX, $SPARKLET has broader market utility — it can be traded externally and is listed on exchanges, making it a key token for players interested in the crypto side of Upland. For players not crypto-native, Sparklet can be purchsaed in game.

[🔥 Required for manufacturing](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/manufacturing)
[📈 Where to buy Sparklet](https://upland-guide.com/economy/sparklet/where-to-buy-sparklet)

STEM

Life Token · Sustaining the Living Metaverse

# Upland Gamified UPX Earnings : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/economy/gamified-upx-earnings
Your ability to earn in the Upland Metaverse is a direct function of your engagement in the game. By completing tasks during each [Upland season](https://upland-guide.com/metaverse-seasons), you can increase the amount of UPX that you will earn for the following season. The minimum base earnings is set to 4.9% annually and players have the ability to increase their earnings to 15.19% (3.1x the base earnings!). This page will detail everything you need to know about how to increase your earnings. Check out this video to learn the [pros and cons of this earning method](https://youtu.be/Q1VtQM-MgFg).

To increase your earnings from the base, you must complete tasks. Even by completing only one task you are able to increase your earnings. From the [list below](https://upland-guide.com/), for each completed task you will increase the earnings for the following season (up to 5 tasks) taking your property yields to 14.7%. Complete all 10 of the tasks to earn the maximum of 15.19% yield. If you are concerned about completing tasks, here are some [strategies you could adopt that are not based around chasing property earnings.](https://youtu.be/LrUPAvSFyIc) Furthermore, use our [Seasonal UPX Earnings Calculator](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SY_ylv0z4kAe4ftjosjX2-MaiGk-pDK8JHZzIoQp-7s/edit?usp=sharing) to calculate your potential earnings.

- **0 Tasks completed** results in the minimum base earnings of **4.9%** annual earnings.

- **1 Task Complete (Multiplier 1.2x)** results in a **5.88%** annual earning.

- **2 Tasks Completed (Multiplier 1.5x)** boosts the earnings to **7.35%**.

- **3 Tasks Completed (Multiplier 2x)** boosts the earnings to **9.8%**.

- **4 Tasks Completed (Multiplier 2.5x)**boosts the earnings to **12.25%**.

- **5 Tasks Completed (Multiplier 3x)** boosts the earnings to **14.7%**.

- **Complete all 10 tasks (Multiplier 3.1x)**: boosts the earnings to **15.19%**. Also obtain the [completionist badge.](https://upland-guide.com/2025/06/02/completionist-badge) Burning a [season pass](https://upland-guide.com/metaverse-seasons/season-pass) will grant you a wildcard token, enabling you to miss one task this season (excluding the season long residents or influence score missions)

There are 6 seasons, each on starting on the first of every even month (February, April, June, August, October, December) and each season lasts 6 weeks. Every week there are new tasks announced that players can complete in the upcoming week. Each new set of missions are announced on Mondays, with them beginning on Tuesdays at 9AM PT. Each mission **can only be completed during the current week’s missions. **Missed missions cannot be recovered and are gone for good and you will lose out on the opportunity to get the rewards from it retroactively.

Below is the list of tasks that one can complete that will count towards boosting your earnings for the Frost season. Note this list is subject to change from season to season, so make sure to remain engaged.

Sparklet is a very important resource in Upland that enables you to construct non living objects - homes, [map assets](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/outdoor-decor) to place on your properties, [cars](https://upland-guide.com/cars-update), and more in the future. Its important to note that prior to June 2024, Sparklet was know as Spark and had a direct conversion rate of 1 Spark = 1000 Sparklet.

Sparklet weekend is the ideal time to join the metaverse. Learn about all the bonuses you can receive when [signing up for Upland with our referral code.](https://upland-guide.com/referral-bonus)

During the sparklet weekend you can expect to find bonus spark for [leveling up your status](https://upland-guide.com/referral-bonus/spark-level-up-bonus) and a general sale for sparklet. During sparklet weekend, Upland has a sale in the Upland Store.  By purchasing Sparklet within Upland as opposed to crypto exchanges, there are a number of benefits:

Document: What is Sparklet : Upland Guide
Source: https://upland-guide.com/economy/sparklet/what-is-sparklet

# What is Sparklet : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/economy/sparklet/what-is-sparklet
Sparklet is the utility token in the Upland metaverse used to power the creation of non-living elements like [map assets](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/outdoor-decor), [structure ornaments](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/ornaments), [seed Legits](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/upland-legits/seed-legits), and [cars](https://upland-guide.com/transportation/cars). It functions as an ERC-20 token on the Ethereum blockchain, allowing it to be traded outside Upland, but within the metaverse it is non-transferable between players.

Sparklet can be utilized in two different ways - staking and spending. Staking Sparklet is done to build a 3D object that is placed on your property and [charge your vehicle](https://upland-guide.com/transportation/private-transportation/car-charging), and spending Sparklet is done to create Legits.

**Staking Sparklet: **This can be thought of as a construction or factory worker. You send your Sparklet to work at the beginning of the day and he will come back to you when the job is complete. When building in Upland, the time required to create the item is measured in Spark hours (1 Spark = 1,000 Sparklet). In the example below the micro house requires 1,500 Spark hours to build. If you own 3000 Sparklet, it will take you nearly 3 weeks to build the structure.

1500 Spark hours x 1000 Sparklet/Spark / 3000 Sparklet / 24 hr/day = 20.8 days

*

Once the construction has completed, your Sparklet will become available for you to use again. Think of it like the construction worker coming back to you asking for the next task. In this case, your Sparklet does not get "used up", and at any time you can remove your Sparklet from the construction (while ensuring you maintain the minimum stake amount). The same time calculations are used for [manufacturing](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/manufacturing)as well.

**Spending Sparklet - **Legits will be created by spending Sparklet. The first example of this is creating [seed Legits](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/upland-legits/seed-legits) in [Nurseries](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/nursery). These seed Legits can be burned in order to plant an [ornamental plant](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/ornamental-plants) on your property.

Its important to note that within Upland, Sparklet is non-transferable between players and cannot be sold, however players are able to [transfer their sparklet](https://upland-guide.com/economy/sparklet/transfer-sparklet-ethereum) to the Ethereum blockchain where they can freely trade it as an ERC-20 token.

[Learn everything about Sparklet in our free intro to Sparklet course.](https://upland-guide.com/courses/into-to-sparklet)

The best time to obtain sparklet within Upland is during sparklet weekend held every weekend during each [season](https://upland-guide.com/metaverse-seasons). During that time, you can level up or purchase it. Learn more about [sparklet weekend](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/spark/spark-week), and [all the ways to earn sparklet.](https://upland-guide.com/earning-in-upland)

Beyond trading Sparklet as an ERC-20 fungible token on the Ethereum blockchain, players can rent out their Sparklet on third party services as [dev shops](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/layer-2-dev-shops).

Document: What is Sparklet : Upland Guide

Note that in order to collect sparklet through treasure hunting and other methods, you are required to verify your identity with the KYC process (know your customer). [Learn more about that here.](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/tilia-kyc)

To see the type of structures that can be built, and how long they will take, [click here.](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/structure-types) Every quarter, the amount of Sparklet required to complete a structure or other items are subjec to change. [Learn more about how that works here.](https://upland-guide.com/economy/sparklet/history)

Here are some frequently asked questions regarding sparklet and its use.

* 
** 

How do I get sparklet?

- Sparklet can be purchased on the Ethereum blockchain and bridged into Upland.  [Learn where to buy Sparklet here.](https://upland-guide.com/economy/sparklet/where-to-buy-sparklet)

- Sparklet can be earned and won within Upland. [Learn more here.](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/earning-in-upland)

- Sparklet is sold through the Upland store. Each sale, only a limited amount is sold. The price of Sparklet is an average of the market price over the previous 2 weeks.  One of the advantages of buying Sparklet in the game is that you do not have to pay gas fees to bridge the Sparklet into Upland.

Note that when buying from the Upland store, additional charges are added when using the app.  We recommend logging in through a browser (even on your phone) when making purchases from the store.

In order to receive sparklet in many of the avenues detailed above you must verify your identity.[Learn more about the KYC process here.](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/tilia-kyc)

** 
** 

What structure should I build first?

This can be a personal preference, but chances are you don't have a lot of sparklet when you are constructing your first structure.

A micro house is a good choice as it requires the smallest amount of sparklet hours.  Note that you are unable to open a metaventure in a micro house.  Watch [this video](https://youtu.be/1TzkHsHIL6w) as we compare why we recommend building a micro house instead of a small townhouse.

As you start to obtain more sparklet, you have additional options.  Watch this video where I analyze apartment buildings, and why the average player might want to [avoid building an apartment building that requires a lot of sparklet](https://youtu.be/kwqC456WlTU).

** 
** 

How do I build my own house?

Watch this video to [learn how to get started with your first home construction](https://youtu.be/rRGbSqZFoFI), and check out our [property building guidelines](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/structure-types/structure-building-guidelines) that will help you determine how to properly position your home and choose the right building colors.

** 
** 

Why do I need a house?

Structures are needed to open a [Metaventures](https://upland-guide.com/directory/metaventures), or in game businesses. You also need a place to call home and vote.  Learn more about defining your [Upland home](https://upland-guide.com/community/governance-and-voting). A home is also a place where you will be able to display your [Legits](https://upland-guide.com/upland-legits-main)and other NFTs.

** 
** 

Why do I need a house?

Structures are needed to open a [Metaventures](https://upland-guide.com/directory/metaventures), or in game businesses. You also need a place to call home and vote.  Learn more about defining your [Upland home](https://upland-guide.com/community/governance-and-voting). A home is also a place where you will be able to display your [Legits](https://upland-guide.com/upland-legits-main)and other NFTs.

Building homes also contribute to the neighborhood score. New neighborhood collections will be spawned if a neighborhood is one of the first to reach a not yet published development thresh hold. This is not limited to only the number of structures built in the neighborhood, but also the type of structure.  [Learn more about neighborhood ratings in this video.](https://youtu.be/DWrfZtNC97w)

Watch this video detailing the [top 5 reasons you need a home in the metaverse.](https://youtu.be/0p4rMvtMC6I)

** 
** 

I have built my house, what can I do with it?

Upland is still developing new features, and this is what we know so far about homes:

- New collections are spawned based neighborhood development.  [Learn more about neighborhood collections here.](https://upland-guide.com/community/neighborhood-ratings)

- You can [define your in game home](https://upland-guide.com/community/governance-and-voting). This will also factor in the calculation of which neighborhoods will spawn new collections.  You will be able to vote at a neighborhood, city, and Upland level.  To vote, you are required to have a home.  [Learn more here.](https://upland-guide.com/community/governance-and-voting)

- In the future, you will be able to rent out space in your homes (based on the number of living spaces your structure has)

- You can [open a business](https://upland-guide.com/directory/metaventures) on yourland.

- Sell your property on the secondary market (note that the home is tied to the land, and they must be sold together).

** 
** 

Why is my building taking so long to complete?

Chances are you don't have a lot of sparklet. If you have 1000 sparklet, the smallest structure you can build requires 500 sparklet hours. This means the time it will take is 500,000 sparklet hours / 1000 sparklet = 500 hours (appx. 21 days). This means that if you only have 150 sparklet the time it will take is 500,000 sparklet hours / 150 spark = 3333 hours (138  days or 4.6 months). Read here to find out [how to get more sparklet.](https://upland-guide.com/)

** 
** 

Where is my daily spark login bonus?

If you are not receiving the daily popup to get your daily spark login bonus, where after 7 days of consecutive login, you receive sparklet:

- You have not verified your identity.  [Learn how to do so here.](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/tilia-kyc)

- Go into settings, and there is an option to turn it on.

** 
** 

Why is Sparklet so expensive?

- You are using the Upland app to make purchases from the Upland store.   Note that when buying from the Upland store, additional charges are added when using the app.  We recommend logging in through a browser (even on your phone) when making purchases from the store.

# Entertainment : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/entertainment
Upland describes its Metaverse as a place to play, earn and connect. First and foremost, Upland is a community. We are all citizens of the Metaverse, and we own properties in different cities, and neighborhoods. Players connect and work together to develop their properties, streets, neighborhoods, cities and of course the entire Metaverse. Some of these communities can be found in our [community directory](https://upland-guide.com/business-directory/business-community-category/upland-metaverse-community).

Upland has created opportunities for developers to create their own games and applications that leverage in game assets through [layer 2 dev shop experiences](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/layer-2-dev-shops).

The other two pillars of Upland are play and earn. Upland is built on blockchain technology enabling its players to have ownership over their in game assets. This has created an entire new category of games called "play and earn". In Upland, players are able to earn both UPX, the in game currency as well as USD. Learn more about [all the ways players can earn](https://upland-guide.com/earning-in-upland)** **in Upland. Just by being a part of the Metaverse and owning a property you are in fact playing Upland and also earning. However, this section of the Upland Guide is dedicated to the entertainment aspect of "play". Below are the different things that can be done in Upland that we consider to be entertaining:

- **[Sparklet Warz](https://upland-guide.com/entertainment/sparklet-warz) **- Upland's tower defense game. The goal is for your faction to earn the most points through strategic building, structure decoration and asset placement.

- **[Collecting Legits](https://upland-guide.com/upland-legits) - **Legits are collectible assets of brands that have partnerships with Upland. The first partnership is with the NFL Players Association, FIFA and other soccer clubs where Uplanders can collect NFTs of their favorite NFL or soccer players.

- **[Music Legits -](https://upland-guide.com/entertainment/music-legits)**Connect with your favorite musicians in the metaverse

- [Upland new city releases -](https://upland-guide.com/new-city-release-strategy)New city releases are an exciting opportunity for Uplanders to learn more about a city, and even mint a special property with real world meaning.

- **[Treasure hunting -](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/how-to-treasure-hunt)**Treasure hunting is an exciting way for you to compete against the clock or against other Uplanders for a chance to win both UPX or **Spark**.

- **[Take Upland Tours -](https://upland-guide.com/upland-tours)**Tours are an exciting way to learn more about a real world city. Participating in them have historically awarded people with either a block explorer or with spark.

- **[Car Racing](https://upland-guide.com/entertainment/car-racing) - **Car racing is a way to compete against other players to earn in Upland

- **[Collect Upland Cards -](https://upland-guide.com/nft-upland-cards)**Upland Cards are an NFT project on the WAX blockchain partnered with Upland. These NFTs is the first project that will be able to be uploaded into the Metaverse.

- **Ongoing contests - **Upland hosts a variety of other contests and events that are fun for the community. Check out their [events calendar](https://www.upland.me/events) to see what is up next!

# Car Racing : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/entertainment/car-racing
Car racing is an exciting 3D interactive experience in Upland. Upland Racing has entered the beta testing stage, but the future of racing is bright. Uplanders are able to race cars and [karts](https://upland-guide.com/entertainment/car-racing/karts) to compete with other Uplanders to win more than bragging rights - [but UPX](https://upland-guide.com/entertainment/car-racing/racing-for-stakes)! One of the most exciting opportunities that racing provides is that players are able to create [speedway metaventures](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/speedway-racetrack) where you can design your own racetracks and in the future create their own public or private racing leagues where they can compete with their friends.

[Race for stakes](https://upland-guide.com/entertainment/car-racing/racing-for-stakes), increase your [MPS (Maximum Performance Score)](https://upland-guide.com/entertainment/car-racing/maximum-performance-score)and compete in [Upland's seasonal racing series](https://upland-guide.com/metaverse-seasons/racing-series) to win UPX, [badges](https://upland-guide.com/community/3d-avatar-identity/upland-badges)and other great prizes. If you are looking for a racetrack to race, consider one of the [Upland Guide's tracks.](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/dales-metaventures/speedways)

Racing will obviously require a car (or kart), and also a [block explorer](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/block-explorers). Block explorers will function as the drivers of the cars. Each car and in the future, block explorer will have unique traits, thus creating near infinite different combinations of drivers, cars, and race tracks to make competitions more interesting. Learn more about car racing in the video below or in our [YouTube playlist](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL3zT4OlFr_bl5A6RG8eQOIR302J6M9bAf). You can [learn how to join a race here.](https://upland-guide.com/entertainment/car-racing/join-a-race)New players are able to test out the racing feature through completing the start a race mission. [Learn more about this mission and others here](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/missions). As more information about cars is shared, you can expect the content on the Upland Guide to be updated. Learn more about racing in [this interview with Masschef](https://youtu.be/nAruZG4daJU) - the cofounder of the Ultimate Racing League.

Upland has a partnership with Stock Car Pro Series in Sao Paulo Brazil, where you can collect Legits, and participate in exclusive Stock Car Pro Series races at the Interlagos racetrack. [Learn more about the partnership here.](https://upland-guide.com/upland-partnerships/stock-car-pro-series)

Don't forget to download the Upland Racing app to your phone in order to race on mobile. [Learn how to connect the app to your account here.](https://www.canva.com/design/DAFoFIXtNGQ/UCTE-rhlZQeqdXIvlOLiRQ/watch?utm_content=DAFoFIXtNGQ&utm_campaign=designshare&utm_medium=link&utm_source=publishsharelink)

If you are looking to have car racing become a big part of your Upland experience, you may want to consider designing your own race track. Click here to learn [what you should consider when designing a race track](https://upland-guide.com/entertainment/car-racing/design-racetracks), and [learn how you can earn UPX through racing.](https://upland-guide.com/entertainment/car-racing/racing-for-stakes)

# XStacks : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/entertainment/xstacks-home
The first casual game on X is XStacks - a Tetris like game created by Upland where you can win Sparklet rewards

XStacks is a play and earn 3d blocks mini game where players can win [Sparklet](https://upland-guide.com/courses/into-to-sparklet)- the utility token that is used to build the Upland Metaverse. XStacks is the first X-native game that is not only made on X, but it's made ** *for * **X. This innovative game leverages the social connectivity of the X platform where its powered by the community that turn your posts on X into integral part of the gameplay.

Make sure to follow [Upland](https://x.com/UplandMe), [XStacks](https://x.com/XStacks_Game), and us - the [Upland Guide](https://x.com/upland_guide) on X.

Score points by clearing blocks similar to Tetris, completing the 99 available levels, and by sharing links to your completed level on X. When players complete a level through your link, you will earn as a bonus 10% of the points they were awarded for that level.

All points awarded help to contribute to your team's score. Each team is a city that exists in the Upland metaverse. Players who contribute points to the top 3 teams at the end of the campaign share in the Sparklet prize pool.

XStacks players don't need to be a player in Upland in order to get started with XStacks, but in order to claim any Sparklet rewards you will need to have reached Uplander status within the game and [connect your XStacks account to your Upland account](https://upland-guide.com/entertainment/xstacks-home/connect-upland-account). [Learn how to become an Uplander here](https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/becoming-an-uplander), and below this video you can see a step by step instructions on how to get started.

# City Tiers and Vanilla Mode : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/city-tiers-and-vanilla-mode
As of November 19, 2021, every new city released in Upland is classified within a new tier system. Upland has a city tier ranking based on the PSI System - Price, Size, and Icon Factor, where each parameter is given a ranking from 1-3. Treasure hunting tiers differ from city tiers, and you can learn [more below](https://upland-guide.com/).

**Price **refers to the average real world prices of homes in the city. A ranking of 1 refers to the most expensive, and 3 being the least expensive.

**Size **refers to the number of overall properties in the city and its overall area. A ranking of 1 refers to the largest, and 3 being the smallest.

**Icon Factor** refers to the measure a city's status. How well known is it around the world? A ranking of 1 refers to world famous cities, and 3 refers to unknown cities.

For example, Manhattan is a world-renowned city known for high property prices but is actually on the smaller end in terms of size. As such, Manhattan would be classified as a 1-3-1 (price - size - icon) City. While its icon factor and property prices are certainly among the top cities in the world, it falters in terms of overall size. See below a [complete list of the different tiers](https://upland-guide.com/).

The previous tier system was less flexible and only has 3 city tiers (high, mid, low) and the tiers were based on the real world status of the city.

The city tier influences the following factors:

- [Send fees](https://upland-guide.com/visiting-fees-and-sends)

- Number of [collections](https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/collections)

- Percent of [FSA properties](https://upland-guide.com/fsa-properties)

It is probably impossible to remember all the details of the 27 new city tiers, so [read this blog post](https://upland-guide.com/breaking-down-new-city-tiers) that breaks it down in an easy way to understand.

When cities are announced, Upland notifies everyone what tier the city is part of, and also the release method of the collections. Collections are always predefined before the city release, but they are not always shared with the community before the release. If they are shared, this information will typically be done only a few hours before the actual release of the city. If not, the city will be released in vanilla mode. Read here about what strategies are available to you when [participating in a new city release](https://upland-guide.com/new-city-release), and [how to prepare](https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/new-city-release-strategy/preparing-for-a-new-city) for a new release. If you are participating in your first new city release, we recommend reading this page that describes the entire [new city release process](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/new-city-release-process) and clarifies a number of frequently asked questions about the topic.

Table of all city tiers

Send fees are listed as minimum/default/maximum

### Treasure Hunting Tiers

Treasure hunting tiers differ from the city tiers listed above. There are 5 different treasure hunting tiers. Here is a [complete list of cities and their hunting tier](https://upland-guide.com/starting-city). [Everything you need to know about treasure hunting can be found here.](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/how-to-treasure-hunt)

### Vanilla Mode City Release

[Everything you need to know about treasure hunting can be found here.](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/how-to-treasure-hunt)

### Vanilla Mode City Release

When the collection properties of a city are not shared with the community beforehand, the city is released in what is called "vanilla mode". Upland defines the collection properties and boost rates before the release, mints it on the blockchain but only later is shared with the public. Only after the large majority of the collection properties have been mined, are collections revealed.

The most exciting part in my opinion about vanilla mode city releases is the need to research the city. If you have ever gone on a big roadtrip or traveled to a new city, you want to find out where is the downtown, what are the landmarks, best restaurants, attractions, etc. Typically, collections are related to important neighborhoods and streets in the city. Especially in the new age of Covid-19 as people are traveling less, Upland can provide a bit of escape-ism. The best part is that you could potentially be the owner of one of those great properties! Read our [top 5 reasons that we love vanilla releases](https://upland-guide.com/vanilla-release-top-5).

Approximately one week after the city is released, the collections are revealed. This is exciting because you might find out that the random property you purchased could be part of an ultra rare collection, and it could be worth in upwards of 1,000,000 UPX! [Watch this video](https://youtu.be/qAP7ckvi-JE) to understand why you should consider removing your properties from the secondary market **before **the collection reveal.
