# How to Earn in Upland : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/earning-in-upland
Upland is a play to earn game enabling you to earn USD for playing! This site details all the ways you can earn UPX, Sparklet and USD while playing!

Earning in Upland takes on several forms. There are three types of currency that you can earn in Upland.

- UPX - the in game currency within Upland (not to be confused with the crypto coin of the same name. They are unrelated).

- US Dollars

- [Sparklet](https://upland-guide.com/economy/sparklet), an ERC-20 crypto token on the Ethereum blockchain. This utility token is used to power the creation of non-living elements in Upland

- [STEM](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/stem), the token responsible for sustaining all living things in the metaverse.

In addition to these the [Stem](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/stem)token is an in game utility token that powers living items in Upland.

If you are a new player and you are looking to find out how you can earn your first 10,000 UPX in order to become an Uplander, [this page](https://upland-guide.com/becoming-an-uplander)details all the different ways of doing that. Don't forget to use our [referral code](https://upland-guide.com/referral-bonus) for additional UPX bonuses when signing up for Upland. Learn more about the [Upland economy](https://upland-guide.com/economy) here or watch our [YouTube playlist](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL3zT4OlFr_bm1m090BLqnn-NZfJIktYi3) of the same title.

Note that in order to earn USD or sparklet you must first verify your identity through the KYC process (know your customer). [Learn more here.](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/tilia-kyc)

Browse our playlist below to learn all the ways to earn in USD, UPX, Ethereum and sparklet! If you are a brand or an individual looking to get a fast start in the Metaverse, consider looking at the [consulting services we provide.](https://upland-guide.com/about/consulting-services)

#### Earn USD

** 
** 

Sell property

[Guide directory](https://upland-guide.com/directory) also lists other businesses that provide other tools. Properties that are part of [collections](https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/collections) typically have much higher markup values. If you are able to mint one of those properties, it is a great way to increase your net worth quickly. If you own a home or other type of structure on your property, the value of that property is significantly higher than a property without one. The value of a structure has no base definition in the game, and is completely determined by the market. You can sell properties for both UPX and USD.

** 
** 

Sell assets in a metaventure as a sub-merchant

Block explorers, Legits and other items can be sold in Metaventures for UPX, as well as for USD.  Learn more here about [how to sell your asset in a metaventure as a sub-merchant](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/sub-merchants).  Here you can find a [list of the different types of metaventures](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures) that exist and what can be sold.

Completing a property collection

Collect visiting fees

When someone visits a property that is not their own, the player must pay the visitor fee. Depending on the city, the visiting fees vary. The minimum and maximum prices can vary from 5 UPX to 100 UPX. Within the fixed range, the owner of a property is able to set the visiting fees for each of their properties. It is important to note that if you receive a visit from a visitor, the fee is not immediately paid out. Only once he becomes an uplander is the visitor fee paid out. If you are playing for free, there are many communities who will visit your properties to help you reach uplander status. Aside from this, do not expect that receiving visits will be a substantial source of revenue for you. Read more about sends [here](https://upland-guide.com/visiting-fees-and-sends).

Rent out sparklet

Sparklet is the resource used to build structures on your properties. Read more about sparklet and how to get it [here](https://upland-guide.com/economy/sparklet). If you own sparklet, there are numerous people and/or groups that are willing to pay you to rent your spark.  In the future there will be the ability within the game to rent out your sparklet, but for now all the deals are made directly between the players, typically within discord channels. You can be paid by UPX transfers, visits to your property purchasing of burner properties, etc.

# How to Travel in Upland? : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/how-to-travel-in-upland
How to travel in the Upland Metaverse. Make sure to avoid the most common travel mistakes and how to get to and from the JFK airport in Manhattan

There are two ways to travel around the Upland metaverse. Moving within a city and moving to a new city use different mechanics - sends and travel. Sends are used to transport yourself within the city your block explorer is located in. [Sending](https://upland-guide.com/visiting-fees-and-sends)yourself to a different property is instantaneous and costs less than 125 UPX depending on the city you are in. Travelling is used when you want to move to a different city. This act takes time (a function of distance) as well as more UPX - depending on the means of travel that are required to travel to these cities. If you have a vehicle of you own and you want to drive it between cities, [this page](https://upland-guide.com/transportation/private-transportation) details how that is to be done. If you are stuck in the Greater New York area, [this page](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/how-to-travel-in-upland/travel-nyc) will teach you how to navigate between the cities.

Below are some common travel FAQs

** 
** 

I can't find any sends / I ran out of sends

If you ran out of sends or have less than 3, after 24 hours, Upland will replenish those 3 sends. You are able to hold a maximum of 11 sends at any given time, and you can collect 40 sends in one day. It is ill advised to use your last send without sending yourself to another airplane to collect more sends. This is especially critical during new city releases. Read more about sends [here](https://upland-guide.com/visiting-fees-and-sends).

** 
** 

I am clicking on a send but I am unable to collect it

- If you are using a firefox browser, there is a known bug regarding your ability to collect sends. Try using a different browser or the mobile app.

- You already have the maximum number of sends you can collect

- Your block explorer is not in range of the airplane. Send yourself to a minted property close to the send in order to collect it.

** 
** 

There are no available spots at a terminal to travel

This can happen prior to new city releases where there is an increased travel demand.  These travel spots in terminals reset ever day.  If you miss an opportunity to travel, you could wait for the next day, or there might be an additional way to access the terminal.  Try sending yourself to a property close by - it might be in range of the terminal.  [Watch this video to see how its done.](https://youtu.be/3x18ZJ2Nz6M)

** 
** 

How do I get to or from the New York airport?

In order to get to the NYC airport, you must be in Manhattan. From there, zoom out and click on the airport which is to the east of Brooklyn to send yourself there. # Treasure Hunting : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/how-to-treasure-hunt
Treasure hunting is a fun way to try and win UPX or [sparklet](https://upland-guide.com/economy/sparklet)*. Hunting requires you to send your block explorer to different properties around a city based on hints to get in close proximity of the treasure in order to claim it. If you have never treasure hunted before, you should [understand these basic things](https://upland-guide.com/top-5-things-to-understand-before-treasure-hunting) about treasure hunting before continuing reading this page. It is important to note that as you begin hunting for treasures you should expect to lose more UPX than you will win. Treasure hunting is a skill and just like most skills, they require practice. In the long run if you are able to master the skill, it can be very profitable. Here is a video I created explaining [why I decided to stop treasure hunting.](https://youtu.be/8VGLUpGnybo)

*Note that in order to participate in exclusive and rare hunts and collect spark through treasure hunting you are required to verify your identity with the KYC process (know your customer). [Learn more about that here.](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/tilia-kyc)

Cities are categorized into tiers, and the city tier does not always coincide with the city treasure hunting tier. Based on the tier the UPX bonuses and spark bonuses vary. See here the [list of cities](https://upland-guide.com/starting-city) and their treasure hunting tier. As some cities have additional releases, you can expect their treasure hunting tiers to increase. [Learn more about how that happens here.](https://upland-guide.com/2023/11/17/treasure-hunting-tier-adjustment)

There are 4 different types of main treasure hunts, increasing in difficulty, and therefore the rewards are also higher. Through the dynamic treasuring hunting schedule competitive treasure hunts are not available in all cities simultaneously. On a weekly basis the cities that have competitive hunts available changes. Stay tuned to Upland's announcements to know where you can hunt.

** 
** 

Standard

Standard hunts are the only type where you do not complete against other players - only the clock. You get one free standard treasure hunt each 24 hour period, but you can complete more (theoretically infinite - more on that later) for paying a small UPX fee (depending on the city tier.  See table below for more detials) for each hunt. You are given 5 minutes to find the treasure. Click a property close to your block explorer and then the treasure hunt button within the property card. This will reveal you the hint. Based on that hint, send your block explorer to another property to reveal the hint there, in the hopes that the hints indicate that you are getting closer to the treasure. Repeat this process until you find the treasure, run out of sends, run out of time, or give up.

*

Source: https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/how-to-treasure-hunt

*

Depending on the city you are in you can only use a maximum of approximately 40 sends each 24 hour period. When treasure hunting or for any other reason, sending your block explorer to a property you own does not result in the loss of a send. Therefore the more properties you own in a city that are strategically spread out will decrease the sends you must make to properties that you don't own. This means that in theory, the more properties you have also result in your ability to treasure hunt for a longer period of time before you reach the maximum number of daily sends. If you never have to send yourself to a property not owned by you, you could hunt forever.

To create a good network of properties for the purpose of standard treasure hunting, it is recommended to own anywhere from 10-20 properties (depending on the city size) **minimum**. These properties should be strategically scattered around the city. As you begin to earn UPX from hunting, use those earnings to mint/purchase more properties that fill in your network. In the long run, it will decrease the number of sends you need to use while hunting, and also increasing the likelihood of finding sends near your properties. Below you can see Mossijake's property network in Brooklyn. With this type of network, a treasure can typically be found with using only 2 sends.

In February 2023, [Upland announced changes to treasure hunting](https://www.upland.me/events/standard-treasure-cost-multipliers-and-competitive-tier-cooldowns). The changes that affect the treasure hunters who likely spend more than 20 minutes a day hunting are spawn cost multipliers.  The proposed change will increase that fee as you spawn more daily treasures. This means that at some point it may not make economic sense for you to continue to treasure hunt after a certain point and that the number of daily sends you have will no longer be the limiting factor.

* 
** 

Limited

To participate in a Limited Exclusive, or rare treasure hunts, click the treasure button on any property. If a treasure is active you will see a hint. If not, it will say "treasures are recharging". Alternatively you can click the 3 dots at the bottom middle of the screen and choose treasures. From this screen you can see the status of the treasures.

The image below shows that the Limited treasure hunt is still in cool down mode. The countdown clock on the Executive hunt indicates when the hunt will start. As for the Standard hunt, since the daily free one was completed already, you are able to spawn more hunts for 50-125 UPX each (depending on the city tier).

*

*

Limited treasure hunts are free to participate in - but you compete against all other players who are also hunting. Once a treasure it found, it goes into a cool down mode where that treasure hunt is unavailable. The player that won the treasure hunt also goes into a cool down mode, where he is unable to participate for that cooldown period (1 hour) for other limited treasure hunts. A 5 minute countdown is provided prior to beginning the next hunt. The concept and strategy is the same as the standard hunt, but you will have to be faster as there could be dozens of people looking for the same treasure. If a certain thresh hold of players is reached who are hunting, then riot mode is enabled where the prize is doubled! Since you are competing against other players, to win a hunt you likely have to find the treasure within 40 seconds. Having a vast treasure

* 
** 

Exclusive

Exclusive treasures are the same as Limited ones. They spawn less frequently and therefore the rewards you can find are higher. Below you can see the hint is a yellow arrow. This is indicative that it is an Exclusive treasure. Limited treasures are purple and Standard is blue. These color codes take after the collection colors.

Once you find an exclusive treasure, you are placed on a 3 hour cooldown where you are unable to see exclusive treasure hints.

*

There is a second type of Exclusive treasures that are "stealth" treasures. In order to see the hints for them, you must be less than 1km away from the treasure. Finding this treasure takes a lot of luck. Send yourself between your properties without wasting sends and paying for visits in the hopes that you get close enough to find a hint.

Exclusive and rare treasure hunts are not available in tier 5 cities.  Here is a [list of all the cities](https://upland-guide.com/starting-city) and their treasure hunting tier.

To participate in exclusive and rare hunts you must have [verified your identity through the KYC process](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/tilia-kyc) (know your customer)

* 
** 

Rare

Rare hunts function like exclusive ones, where the color of the arrow is red. They spawn less frequently, but the payout is higher.

Once you find an rare treasure, you are placed on an 8 hour cooldown where you are unable to see exclusive treasure hints.

Exclusive and rare treasure hunts are only available in tier 1 cities.  Here is a [list of all the cities](https://upland-guide.com/starting-city) and their treasure hunting tier.

Sparked up

These hunts are only available  during a few days within [spark week](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/spark/spark-week).  These treasure chests function like limited treasures, however the payout is always in [spark](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/spark)!  Note that riot mode for double payout is not an option for these hunts, even if the number of people hunting passes the thresh hold.

** 
** 

Treasure Rush

A treasure rush is a competition created around the concept of standard treasure hunting.  In this competition players race against the clock to find as many treasures as possible within 15 minutes.  Players have unlimited sends for these 15 minutes (you still have to pay the visitors fee to any property you land on). After finding a treasure you can spawn a new one for only 10 UPX.  The top 50 players who find the most treasures in the 15 minute timeframe win UPX based on their rankings.  Even if you aren't one of the top ranked players, each treasure you find does have UPX in them.

This competition rotates between cities, so its important to follow Upland's schedule.  A player can only do the treasure hunt once in each city, and the competition is open for 24 hours in each of the scheduled cities.

Below you can see the cost of spawning standard treasures. The numbers in the brackets represent the treasure spawned that day. For example, if you are spawning your 23rd treasure in a T2 city, it will cost you 150 UPX. Every day at 12AM PT the timer resets, and your spawn fee does as well.

# New City Release Process : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/new-city-release-process
New city releases in Upland are one of the more exciting aspects of the game. Participating in a [new city release is the best way to grow your net worth](https://upland-guide.com/new-city-release). Upland releases cities on a regular basis - primarily as the user base continues to grow and when a new partnership is announced. Here is a [list of cities](https://upland-guide.com/starting-city) in Upland and their property availability. It seems that Upland wants to control the ability for there to be properties available at reasonable prices for new players who are starting out. [FSA properties](https://upland-guide.com/fsa-properties) fit this need as they can only be minted by Uplanders (net worth less than 100,000 UPX). Some cities are often expanded upon, to meet future demand by new players. A city expansion follows a lot of the same process detailed below with some modifications. Learn more about [city expansions here.](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/new-city-release-process/city-expansions)

If you have not participated in a new city release, the process leading up to it can be confusing and overwhelming. This page will explain in greater details the process, what to expect and clarify many of the frequently asked questions regarding new city releases. Watch the video or continue below the video for people who like reading better. Make sure to [test your knowledge](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/quiz-home/new-city-release-quiz) in our new city release quiz as a self assessment of your readiness for a new city release.

** 
** 

The announcement

The first step leading up to a new city release is an announcement by Upland. It is typically done first in their [Discord server](https://discord.gg/yyhEhpwewc) followed up almost immediately on their [Twitter channel](https://twitter.com/uplandme). Their announcement has all the details you need to prepare for the city release, but leaves out many important small details that new players require. The announcement indicates the city to be released, the date and time of the release, city information, travel routes, terminal sales and other activities around the city release.

During some city releases, Upland will sell City Passes.  [Learn about those here.](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/new-city-release-process/city-pass)

** 
** 

City information

The city information is an important indication of its tier within the Metaverse. Based on the [PSI index](https://upland-guide.com/city-tiers-and-vanilla-mode)(price, size, icon status) you are able to see how this city fits within the Metaverse. One thing Upland does not disclose is the price aspect. The actual [neighborhood values, which are used to determine the mint price of a property](https://upland-guide.com/property-card) are not discoverable until several hours before the city release. Information that is provided are send fees, if the city has an airport, the number of [collections](https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/collections), percentage of [FSA properties](https://upland-guide.com/fsa-properties), and [treasure hunting](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/how-to-treasure-hunt) tier.

title: New City Release Process : Upland Guide
text:
Document: New City Release Process : Upland Guide
Source: https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/new-city-release-process

The city information is an important indication of its tier within the Metaverse. Based on the [PSI index](https://upland-guide.com/city-tiers-and-vanilla-mode)(price, size, icon status) you are able to see how this city fits within the Metaverse. One thing Upland does not disclose is the price aspect. The actual [neighborhood values, which are used to determine the mint price of a property](https://upland-guide.com/property-card) are not discoverable until several hours before the city release. Information that is provided are send fees, if the city has an airport, the number of [collections](https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/collections), percentage of [FSA properties](https://upland-guide.com/fsa-properties), and [treasure hunting](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/how-to-treasure-hunt) tier.

Another important piece of information provided is whether the city will be released in regular or [vanilla mode.](https://upland-guide.com/city-tiers-and-vanilla-mode) Vanilla more means that the collection are not revealed until approximately 1 week after the city is released. This gives people equal opportunity to mint extremely valuable rare and ultra rare collection properties. In regular city releases, ultra rare collection properties are typically not available for mint. They are typically given away in contests or sold in other methods after the release. Read [why Dale the Llama prefers vanilla releases](https://upland-guide.com/top-5-reasons-we-love-vanilla-releases) to regular city releases.

Once this announcement is done, we recommend you begin doing research about the city. The best place to do this is google. The best way to think about it is to pretend you are planning a real world vacation to that city. What famous sites are there, what are the popular neighborhoods and streets (for potential collections), etc. This can give you a good start in forming a strategy for the new city release. Start thinking of what areas you want to mint in, and what your budget is (either in UPX or if you plan on buying UPX before the city release). Click here to [best prepare yourself for a new city release.](https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/new-city-release-strategy/preparing-for-a-new-city)

** 
** 

Travel to new city

Travel between cities is done by [public](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/how-to-travel-in-upland) or [private](https://upland-guide.com/transportation/private-transportation) transportation. You can't just send your block explorer directly from one city to another like you do within a city. One of the biggest misconceptions is that once the announcement is made you will be able to travel to the new city. This is simply not the case (unless the released city is an extension of an existing one, like London or Tokyo).

Before anyone can travel to a new city, one terminal will be minted by Upland and then players will be able to begin traveling to the city.  Travel routes and prices are detailed in Upland's announcement.

** 
** 

Opening travel routes

Following the minting of the terminals, another announcement is made by Upland indicating when the travel routes are open for people to travel to the new city. This is done typically at least 24 hours before any sort of release.

title: New City Release Process : Upland Guide
text:
Document: New City Release Process : Upland Guide
Source: https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/new-city-release-process

** 
** 

Opening travel routes

Following the minting of the terminals, another announcement is made by Upland indicating when the travel routes are open for people to travel to the new city. This is done typically at least 24 hours before any sort of release.

Pro tip - before travelling to the new city, make sure to to start your journey with the maximum number of sends. You won't be able to pick up any new sends in the new city until the release. Watch our [video to learn how to travel between cities in Upland](https://youtu.be/fF5-KH5-Tck).

It is important to note that each terminal has a daily limit of players that can pass through it. This might mean that not everyone will be able to travel to a new city. Upland does make sure to temporarily increase those numbers for new city releases as they want to accommodate more players. All we can say is plan accordingly, or watch this [video on how you can sometimes get around this obstacle](https://youtu.be/3x18ZJ2Nz6M).

** 
** 

City release

Ahead of the release, if you are looking to strategize around which properties you want to mint given your budget, [learn how to calculate the property mint prices before the release.](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/new-city-release-process/calculating-mint-price-of-upland-property-at-new-city-release)

A 5 minute notice is provided prior to the release of the city in Discord and Twitter. If the city is a regular release where the collections are known, Upland will announce those collections several hours before the city release. Once the city is open, the entire city will turn from white properties to grey, and an area around your block explorer will turn light green.

In Upland's initial announcement, they typically define a number of properties scattered around the city that are pre-minted by Upland.  These "launchpad properties" allow players to send themselves to those properties in order to get closer to areas they may wish to mint, or to use it as a launchpad to send their block explorer in the right direction.

If you are far away from a property you wish to mint,  you will have to wait for someone else to mint a property nearby first first. In Upland, you can only send your block explorer to minted properties. People who find themselves already in the area they wish to mint have an advantage over other players because they will likely be able to mint properties before you have the opportunity to send your block explorer to a minted address. You may find yourself trying to play catchup as players who are half a step ahead of you are minting properties you are going for.  There is a 10 second cool down after minting a property before you will be able to mint the next one, so its important to be decisive and quick thinking regarding the properties you plan on minting.

Watch our video about [how to mint a property](https://youtu.be/ylgh3KsL_pw) if you have never minted one before.

title: New City Release Process : Upland Guide
text:
Document: New City Release Process : Upland Guide
Source: https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/new-city-release-process

Watch our video about [how to mint a property](https://youtu.be/ylgh3KsL_pw) if you have never minted one before.

Most importantly, familiarize yourself with the [top mistakes made by players during new city releases](https://upland-guide.com/top-mistakes-new-city-release) and the [new city release strategy for new players.](https://upland-guide.com/new-city-release)

** 
** 

Terminal sale and minting

When the city releases, Upland owns the only terminal, as the remainder of them are sold after the city release.  Players who purchase a terminal will still benefit from the [terminal profit sharing](https://upland-guide.com/2023/07/15/profit-sharing-comes-to-upland).  The revenue generated from travel from that terminal will be distributed to the new owners.

Terminals are sold for USD only, therefore registering for the sale is done on the "web version" of the game. This means that you must log in from a browser and not the app in order to register. The same is true for making the actual purchase. Upland will provide another update prior to the opening of the registration. This will include the prices of the terminals that are up for sale. To register, click the yellow "get UPX" button in the upper right corner of the screen and register for the relevant items - once again through a browser and not the app.

Watch this video to see [3 reasons why you might want to purchase a terminal.](https://youtu.be/r_thrMRf_Mk)

**Q: Do I have to register immediately in order to guarantee myself a terminal?**

A: No. You can register at any time during the registration period. After the registration period closes, all registrants are "lined up" for a priority purchasing. There is no correlation between the order that people register to their actual position in the line up. It is also unlikely that the lineup is completely randomized.

**Q: How do I know what position I am in the lineup?**

A: Shortly after the registration closes you will receive an email indicating your spot in the lineup and the time you will be able to make your purchase (assuming the item has not sold out before you get to the front of the line)

**Q: Is it free to register? **

A: Yes. It does not cost you money to register. If it comes your turn in the lineup and you have the opportunity to buy the terminal you can still pass on the opportunity. Since the lineup is unlikely completely random, Dale the Llama thinks that the algorithm does not favor players who register and in the end pass on the opportunity to make the purchase if the terminal is available. He recommends only registering for items that you intend to buy if you have the chance. If you know ahead of time that the terminal is outside your budget or that you will not be available to make the purchase during the sale time (eg. if you will be asleep) Dale recommends not registering. The algorithm may not favor people who successfully make purchases, but it might give lower prioritization in the future to players who don't follow through with purchases.

**Q: If I am at the front of the line but I am unavailable to make the purchase can I give my spot in line to a friend?**

A: No.

**Q: How long do I have to make the purchase once it is my turn?**

A: Approximately 2 minutes. Have your credit card or method of payment ready.

**Q: I missed my turn in line, what can be done?**

A: Nothing.

**Q: I just spent the money to buy the terminal, where is it?**

A: The purchase is in fact to buy the amount of UPX required to mint the terminal. Upland will reach out to you directly via email with further instructions regarding minting the terminal.

** 
** 

Vanilla mode collection reveal

If the city was released in vanilla mode, collections are typically revealed one week after the release. It is important to be aware of this and to remove your properties from the secondary market prior to the collection reveals, [watch here to find out why.](https://youtu.be/qAP7ckvi-JE) Stay tuned in Discord and Twitter for details about collection reveals.

# Upland Assets : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets
Upland Assets are possessions that you own within the game. To view your assets, click on the assets button in the bottom menu. Any player can see your assets by clicking on your block explorer, or by clicking your username on one of the properties you own. You can buy, sell, and trade assets within Upland. (Not all types of assets can currently be bought, sold, or traded yet. More detailed below).

Below is a list of the different types of assets that exist in Upland:

*

* 
** 

Block Explorers

Block Explorers are different avatars that you can use. Block explorers can be won in contests, or purchased through the Upland store during special sales. Once you reach Director status, you can travel to [City Hall in San Francisco](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-city-hall) to apply for a custom 1 of 1 block explorer.   Block explorers can also be bought and sold on the secondary market via [metaventures](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures).

Learn more about block explorers [here](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/block-explorers).

** 
** 

Properties

Properties are the foundation of Upland. Just like in the real world, owning land can be extremely important. Within Upland, it can be important to own land for several reasons:

- owning land provides you with yield on those properties. Currently (updated on October 2022) land owners earn 14.7% annually on the mint price of their properties. This is paid out on a 3 hour basis. Adding properties to [collections](https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/collections) can provide you with a boost to those earnings.

- Hold on to it in the hopes that it will increase in value. Applying simple economic principles such as supply and demand, it can be expected that cities that have [sold out](https://upland-guide.com/starting-city) can expect to see an increase in property pricing as demand for those cities increase.

- Build a structure on your land and set it as your [Upland Home.](https://upland-guide.com/community/governance-and-voting)

- When you have a [car](https://upland-guide.com/intro-to-upland-cars) or other pieces of outdoor decor, you will need a place to put them.

- To open a [metaventure](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures), or in game business.

- to grow your [treasure hunting](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/how-to-treasure-hunt) network in a specific city. Finding treasures (in the form of UPX or [spark](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/spark)) is another great way to earn and grow your net worth.

In Upland, properties can be bought (for UPX or USD), sold (for UPX or USD) and traded for other properties.

[Learn more about the different types of properties in Upland.](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/upland-properties)

Learn more about Upland [real estate](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL3zT4OlFr_bmMZSyuW-VwnQtFT8ILSTwo) and [real estate analysis](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL3zT4OlFr_bk5Fpa1_QbN73lao-JaipuL) in our YouTube playlists

** 
** 

Structures

Structures are homes or other buildings (factories and showrooms) that can be built upon properties that you own. [Sparklet](https://upland-guide.com/economy/sparklet)is a limited resource that is required to build these homes and other inanimate objects. Building a structure on a property will forever link the two together. This means that you can't sell a structure without also selling the land that it is on.

Document: Upland Assets : Upland Guide
Source: https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets

** 
** 

Structures

Structures are homes or other buildings (factories and showrooms) that can be built upon properties that you own. [Sparklet](https://upland-guide.com/economy/sparklet)is a limited resource that is required to build these homes and other inanimate objects. Building a structure on a property will forever link the two together. This means that you can't sell a structure without also selling the land that it is on.

Build a structure on your land and set it as your [Upland Home](https://upland-guide.com/community/governance-and-voting), where you will be able to vote and be part of a community. If you want to open a [metaventure](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures)(in game business), a structure is a prerequisite.

In Upland, structures can be constructed, as well as bought, sold and traded along with the properties they are on.

Click here to see more detailed information about the [types of structures](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/structure-types).

** 
** 

Structure Ornaments

Ornaments are 3D overlay designs that are added to a structure. The first ornaments introduced to Upland were part of the [Spirit Halloween Legits collection](https://upland-guide.com/upland-legits) released in 2021. Players were able to decorate their homes with spooky ornaments.  [Learn more about ornaments here.](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/ornaments)

*

In Upland, structure ornaments can be bought from Upland and traded.  In the future you will be able to sell them in showroom metaventures.

* 
** 

Vehicles

[Vehicles](https://upland-guide.com/transportation/cars) will be required to transport both players, and goods around Upland.  There will be cities that will only be accessible by cars, and travel within a city will be done faster if you use a vehicle.  Goods such as outdoor decor items will have to be shipped between manufacturing plants, show rooms, and maybe even to the owner's properties.

A second use case for vehicles is car racing.  Players will be able to race cars or [karts](https://upland-guide.com/entertainment/car-racing/karts) against other Uplanders to win prizes.  [Read more about car racing here.](https://upland-guide.com/entertainment/car-racing)

** 
** 

Legits

Upland Legits are digital collectible NFTs.  In the future you will be able to show off the artwork in your Upland home, export them outside of Upland where the NFTs can be sold on other NFT marketplaces like OpenSea.

Legits are minted through Upland during special sales, and can be traded between players.  In the future you will be able to sell them in Upland.

[Learn more about the different types of Legits here .](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/upland-legits)

** 
** 

Wearable Legits

Wearables are 3D NFTs that can be worn by your Ready Player Me avatar not only within Upland, but also in other virtual spaces (in the future).

[Learn more about wearables, and why you will need them here.](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/wearables)

** 
** 

Sports Legits

Sports Legits

Sports legits are NFTs of sports players. Currently you can own legits of NFL players, and soccer players.  Each season, [different types](https://upland-guide.com/upland-legits-nfl/upland-legits-nfl-types) of NFTs are created of the players. You are able to [create team collection](https://upland-guide.com/upland-legits-nfl/nfl-fan-point-collections) to boost your fan points and increase your opportunity of obtaining special 1 of 1 mementos and getting these NFTs autographed. Click here to find out how to [get started with NFLPA Legits](https://upland-guide.com/upland-legits-nfl/getting-started-with-nfl-legits), and [soccer Legits](https://upland-guide.com/upland-legits-main/football-legits). If you don't know anything about the NFL, Dale the Llama has a [beginners guide to football](https://upland-guide.com/upland-legits-nfl/getting-started-with-nfl-legits/nfl-beginners-guide).

In Upland, NFLPA and football Legits can be bought from the [designated stadiums](https://upland-guide.com/upland-legits-nfl/stores-and-stadiums), traded and sold through fan stores that operate as [metaventure businesses.](https://upland-guide.com/directory/metaventures)

** 
** 

Uploads

-
Uploads display assets that are imported from outside the Upland Game. In the future you will be able to import NFTs you own on the WAX blockchain (and other blockchains as well) into Upland where you will be able to display them in your home, or even trade or sell them. At the moment only [Upland Cards](https://upland-guide.com/nft-upland-cards) can be uploaded through the [Upland NFT Portal](https://upland-guide.com/nft-portal).

In Upland, at the moment you cannot buy, sell, or trade any of these uploaded assets.

** 
** 

Map Assets

Map assets are 3D items that can be placed on your property.  These items can be things like mail boxes, BBQs, doghouses or anything else you you would like to decorate your property with.

Aside from being visually appealing items to add to your lawn, these items can provide you with utility in user generated games, applications, or communities through layer 2.  [Learn more outdoor decor.](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/outdoor-decor)

These items are manufactured in factories and sold in showrooms.  Learn more about the manufacturing process on [this page](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/manufacturing) or on our [YouTube playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL3zT4OlFr_bkoMstrs8vsUkKJu6PsIrz6).

** 
** 

Map assets - totems

[Totems](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/life/totems) are map assets that are able to produce protem.  Stem is a future token that will power life in the metaverse.  Protem is a precursor to stem, and protem will be directly convertible to stem in the future.  Spending protem on a totem is able to generate additional protem, and thus earn you more stem in the future that can sustain things like animals plants and trees. [Learn more about STEM here.](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/stem)

# Block Explorers : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/block-explorers
Block Explorers are different avatars that you can used and are your [identity in the game](https://upland-guide.com/community/3d-avatar-identity). They also have [stamina](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/block-explorers/stamina), that influences the amount of [troves](https://upland-guide.com/uppies/troves)each one can collect and in the future they will also become drivers in car races. There are some standard avatars that can be chosen that Upland provides based on your [status within the game](https://upland-guide.com/upland-status). All block explorers (with the exception of the standard ones provided) are assets that you own. Each one has its own description and quantities that exist. Block Explorers can be bought from the Upland store, or on [Opensea](https://opensea.io/collection/uplandblockexplorers), player run [metaventures](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/block-explorer-shops), or earned by participating in events or challenges. See here the [block explorer directory](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/block-explorers/block-explorer-directory) to learn about a block explorer's origin, when and under what circumstances it was issued.

Block explorers are your identity in the game. When you [define your Upland home](https://upland-guide.com/community/governance-and-voting), you are also able to generate a custom profile picture with your block explorer. Below is an example of mine with [Dale the Llama](https://upland-guide.com/about/meet-dale), and [learn more about creating your metaverse identity here.](https://upland-guide.com/community/3d-avatar-identity)

Some of the most coveted block explorers are terraformers and wizards, which are introduced when new features are introduced into the metaverse. Learn more about [terraformers and wizards](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/block-explorers/terraformer-wizard) here.

With the introduction of cars, the different block explorers will be drivers of the cars. If you plan on participating in car racing, it will be important to have a quality driver. Since every block explorer is unique, each explorer will also have different characteristics and driving abilities. Watch the video below to learn a bit more, and also read up about [cars in Upland](https://upland-guide.com/cars-update).

Up until 2026, players who reached Director status, were able to travel to [City Hall in San Francisco](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-city-hall) to [apply for a custom 1 of 1 block explorer](https://youtu.be/rtHfIlwNSrQ).

# Block Explorer Stamina : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/block-explorers/stamina
Your [block explorer](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/block-explorers) plays an important role in the Upland Metaverse, as it is your game piece that moves around the map, but stamina adds an important update that will focus on which specific block explorer you have selected. As players collect [troves](https://upland-guide.com/uppies/troves)and [complete recipes](https://upland-guide.com/uppies/troves/recipes), your block explorer will influence how many troves you can gather and recipes you can fulfill before needing to cooldown. This adds more utility to block explorers and adds another layer of decision making that connects movement, ownership and activity within the metaverse.

The stamina feature scales based on rarity. Higher-tier explorers, like [terraformers](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/block-explorers/terraformer-wizard), will be able to operate longer and recover faster, while more common explorers will have tighter limits.

While collecting troves or completing recipes you don't need to actively change your block explorer when it reaches its limit. The system is designed for another explorer to automatically take over, ensuring that gameplay continues without interruption. Players with more (and rarer) block explorers will be able to stay active longer. This new mechanic gives weight to rarity and introduces a reason to think carefully about how each explorer is used.

Every 6 hours your stamina resets, and you will be able to collect more troves. Your stamina can be viewed in your profile, on each block explorer, and within your block explorer assets. There you will also be able to view when the stamina refills. Even if you don't own a block explorer, every player starts with 100 stamina.

**Total Mints** **Stamina**

1 of 1 (excluding director explorers) 1,000

2-5 750

6-10 350

11-24 200

25-50 125

Director Explorer 125

51-100 75

101-250 40

251-400 25

500+ 10

When it comes to trove collecting, there are certain [level Uppies](https://upland-guide.com/uppies/levels/utility) that can automatically collect troves from both [plants](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/ornamental-plants)and structures. The block explorer stamina feature is independent of your Uppie's capacity to collect troves.

Beyond stamina, Upland is exploring modifiers for Block Explorers, where some block explorers may perform better when collecting certain types of troves, while others may improve the likelihood of higher-quality rewards or interact more effectively with specific [service structures](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/structure-types/service-structures). There is also room for time-based or [seasonal](https://upland-guide.com/metaverse-seasons)advantages, where using the right explorer at the right moment can produce better outcomes.

In the future, completing a full series of block explorers could unlock additional benefits that go beyond the sum of their parts. This creates a longer-term incentive structure that rewards both active play and deliberate collecting.

# Ornamental Plants : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/ornamental-plants
Plants are the first life form that exist in the Upland Metaverse, and help to bring your virtual land to life through feeding and cultivation. Ornamental plants come in the form of flowers, shrubs, trees, [grass and sod,](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/ornamental-plants/grass-and-sod)but the variety will grow over time as the Life system expands. All of the different seeds and plants are organized in the [Upland Guide Plant Database](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/upland-legits/seed-legits/plant-database).

To plant a plant, you will have to burn a [seed Legit](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/upland-legits/seed-legits) which can be generated, bought and sold in [nursery metaventures](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/nursery) (grass and sod can be bought directly from the [Upland store](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/upland-upx-store)). Once planted, plants become permanently linked to the property, they’re not NFTs and cannot be transferred independently. Ownership of the plant is tied to the property itself, meaning whoever owns the property, owns the plant. Plants will need to be fed and cultivated, and those that are not will end up dying. To ensure your plants have a "thriving" health status you will need to care for them and maintain their health and wellbeing.

Feeding your plant will require you to spend [Stem](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/stem). This will be done through your main profile, and you can feed all your plants at once. Feeding your plants will maintain their **health.**

Maintaining your plant's **wellbeing **will require you to directly interact with it by clicking it. This task can be completed by any player, building in new opportunities for collaboration and community connection. This can also result in you [earning a trove](https://upland-guide.com/uppies/troves) that will help you to [mint Uppies](https://upland-guide.com/uppies/befriending-uppies). Players can automate the petting, and even the collection of troves on a property by [assigning an Uppie](https://upland-guide.com/uppies/levels/utility/uppie-plant-care)to it.

Here is a more detailed explanation about [health and wellbeing](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/ornamental-plants/health-and-wellbeing). Plants take time to grow and they even change appearances over time to reflect the different [seasons in the year](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/ornamental-plants/seasonal-bloom-cycle). You can choose to fast track the plant's growth by use of [miracle growth](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/ornamental-plants/miracle-grow), by paying some UPX.

See all different plants and other important details regarding them in [Upland Guide Plant Database](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/upland-legits/seed-legits/plant-database). To understand all the costs of gardening, utilize the [Upland Guide Gardening Calculator.](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/upland-legits/seed-legits/plant-database/calculator)

# Plant Health and Wellbeing : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/ornamental-plants/health-and-wellbeing
Maintaining the health and wellbeing of your plants is the core mechanic of plants. Once a [seed](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/upland-legits/seed-legits)is planted on your Upland property, its survival depends on the attention it receives. [Plants](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/ornamental-plants)grow, respond to care, and require consistent interaction — and the two systems below govern everything. Caring for plants will not only keep them alive, but plants on well cared for properties will attract [Uppies and residents.](https://upland-guide.com/uppies)

-

[Health](https://upland-guide.com/)

-

[Wellbeing](https://upland-guide.com/)

- Feed your plant STEM to keep health high — think of it as watering a plant.

- Any player can feed any plant

- Overfeeding is safe, but wastes STEM — feed mindfully

- If health drops to zero, the plant dies permanently

- Health is measured on a scale from 0-100

- The wellbeing of a plant improves through "petting", which represents grooming and maintenance.

- Long-press any plant to pet it — you'll see a visual response confirming it worked

- High wellbeing slows health decay, protecting against random damage events, which can occasionally impact plants as part of a living, dynamic system.

- Low wellbeing speeds up health loss — don't neglect it

- Any player can pet any plant — open to the whole community

- Wellbeing is measured on a scale from 0-100

If you plant dies, it can't be revived, and it will remain on your property until uprooted by the player. These dead plants do not contribute to your property or [neighborhood greenery score](https://upland-guide.com/uppies/residents-score).

Health and Wellbeing also influence the rewards your plants can generate in terms of [troves](https://upland-guide.com/uppies/troves). Plants that are well taken care of are more likely to generate a more rare trove when a player pets it.

Uppies and Residents are drawn to properties where plants are healthy and actively maintained. Players who consistently care for their plants will naturally create spaces that attract more activity to their properties and neighborhoods. Learn more about the [feeding of plants.](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/ornamental-plants/health-and-wellbeing/feeding)

Placing a level 3 Uppie (or higher) on a property will remove the need to actively pet your plants on that property to maintain its wellbeing score. Learn more about [merging Uppies here](https://upland-guide.com/uppies/uppy-merge), and the [utility](https://upland-guide.com/uppies/levels/utility)of the level 3 Uppie.

Document: Plant Feeding : Upland Guide
Source: https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/ornamental-plants/health-and-wellbeing/feeding

# Plant Feeding : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/ornamental-plants/health-and-wellbeing/feeding
Keeping your plants healthy is an important part of life in the Upland metaverse. Aside from the visual aspect of keeping your plants alive and aesthetically pleasing, there are additional benefits to keeping your plants healthy. Learn more about [health and wellbeing of plants.](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/ornamental-plants/health-and-wellbeing)

Feeding plants can be done by clicking on the plant itself, or by going to menu -> assets -> plants. By viewing through the assets tab you are able to see the feeding status, as indicated in the color of the feed button below. Feeding your plant will require you to spend [Stem](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/stem).

The optimal time to feed your plants are when the feed button is green. When feeding the plant when the button is white, you are feeding early, and red represents a sub-optimal feeding time. Clicking the "feed all due" button will feed all the plants whose feed button is either red or green.

A few things to take note of when determining a strategy around when and how to feed your plants:
1 - Feeding a plant with red feed button that has a high health score may not be the best optimization of a feeding the plant
2 - You may want to feed a plant with a low health score but has a white feed button in order to increase its health score. Keep in mind that like the real world watering a plant too frequently is also not good. Spending Stem too often will be a waste of that Stem.
3 - If your time is more valuable than your Stem, using the feed all button is the easiest way to make sure all your plants are fed during their best times.

Back to [health and wellbeing](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/ornamental-plants/health-and-wellbeing)

# The Upland Bureau - and City Hall : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-city-hall
Fittingly, Upland's First City Hall is located in San Francisco - the first city in the Upland Metaverse. The City Hall serves a number of important function, and likely more in the future. The exact address of City Hall is 1 Dr. Carlton B Goodlet Pl., San Francisco California. All Upland cities will have their own city hall, which will be an important location for players to visit. The account that owns the city halls is 'uplandbureau'.

See below the things that can be done in City Hall:

- [Upload your custom block explorer concept](https://upland-guide.com/)

- [Upload your custom model concept](http://custom-model)

- [Metaverse Registration](https://upland-guide.com/)

### Custom Block Explorer

One of the benefits of reaching [Director status](https://upland-guide.com/upland-status) (1,000,000 UPX net worth) is the ability to have a custom 1 of 1 block explorer created just for you. Before travelling to City Hall, make sure you have your design, as well as your block explorer story.

The design can a quick sketch or even a written word explanation. Upland's custom block explorer story policy is detailed below.
[Click here to read the complete guidelines.](https://www.notion.so/uplandme/Content-Guidelines-ccd2db5954e140679ba624c5de480412)

### Custom Model

One of the benefits of reaching [Executive status (](https://upland-guide.com/upland-status)10,000,000 UPX net worth) is the ability to have a custom model created just for you. This 3D object can be placed on one of your Upland properties. Before travelling to City Hall, make sure you have your design, as well as your story.

### Metaverse Registration

City Hall will serve as the place to register for your metaventure. Its important to note that you must travel to the city hall in the city where you want to create the metaventure. [Read more about metaventures here.](https://upland-guide.com/directory/metaventures)

# Upland Status : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-status
As you begin to level up, the game begins to change, and so will your strategy. There is no right or wrong strategy and there is no way to "win" at Upland. Don't be discouraged when you see players with a net worth of millions of UPX. You don't know how much money they have invested, or how long they have been playing for. There is a place for everyone in Upland. This page will detail what you are able to do at each status, as well as some common strategies to help you get to the next level

There are 8 different statuses in Upland: Note that the in game currency UPX is valued at $1 USD = 1000 UPX. (the cryptocurrency UPX is not related and a mere coincidence)

Where net worth is the sum of the following:

- Your total UPX value (the amount of liquid UPX you have).

- Property value. This is the total amount of UPX spent on properties (minting + secondary market values)

In addition to your status, a second metric that helps to measure your journey is the progression score. [Learn more about that here.](https://upland-guide.com/uppies/troves/progressions-score)

** 
** 

Visitor: < 10,000 UPX net worth

- You do not yet own your digital assets. This only happens once you reach uplander status. This is the reason you must renew your visa at least once every 7 days. You can do this by logging in to Upland and within your profile click renew visa. There is no limit to the amount of times you can do this.

- You may mint properties. [FSA properties](https://upland-guide.com/fsa-properties) are reserved for new players and are typically the cheapest ones available. Watch this video to learn [how to mint cheap FSA properties.](https://youtu.be/bZizjkz8nEg)

- You are not able to sell or trade properties (this is because you do not yet own your digital assets)

- You are not able to own [sparklet](https://upland-guide.com/economy/sparklet), or other assets aside from properties. If you have won spark either through treasure hunting or a contest, you must level up before the item is delivered to you otherwise you forfeit it.

** 
** 

Uplander: 10,001 – 100,000 UPX net worth

- You own your digital assets. A digital wallet is created for you on the EOS blockchain. Here all your in game assets are recorded and providing you proof of ownership

- You are able to sell and trade your properties on the marketplace

- You are able to purchase [FSA properties](https://upland-guide.com/fsa-properties)

- You are able to sell properties for USD after owning it for 30 days.

- You are able to list 20 properties for sale in USD at any given time.

- You are able to own [sparklet](https://upland-guide.com/economy/sparklet), but you must verify your identity through the [KYC Process](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/tilia-kyc).

- If you wait until [sparklet weekend](https://upland-guide.com/economy/sparklet/sparklet-weekend) to level up you will get an 30 sparklet.

** 
** 

Pro: 100,001 – 1,000,000 UPX net worth

Executive: 10,000,001 – 100,000,000 UPX net worth

Source: https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/visiting-fees-and-sends

# Visiting Fees and Sends : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/visiting-fees-and-sends
Visiting properties in Upland is an integral part of the game. You must visit properties for the following reasons:

** 
** 

Mint a new property out of range

In order to mint a property, you must be in range of it. In the image below you can see that different properties have different colors. Watch our YouTube video about [how to mint a property](https://youtu.be/ylgh3KsL_pw).

-

Grey - a property that has not been minted

-

Light Green - a property that is available to be minted. If it says FSA, only Uplanders and Visitors are able to mint it. Read more about [FSA properties and their restrictions here](https://upland-guide.com/fsa-properties).

-

Light Blue - a property that is owned by another player and **is not** listed for sale on the secondary market.

-

Dark Green - a property owned by another player and **is** listed for sale on the secondary market.

-

Dark Blue - property owned by you.

*

To mint a grey property you must be in range, so you want to send your block explorer as close as possible to the property you want to mint. If there are many options, you can look around to determine the cheapest fee. The visitor fee can be seen in the property card. In the picture above, you can see that I had sent my block explorer to the blue property that I own. He starts to move in the north-east direction, as you can see based on the black trail. As the block explorer moves forward, more properties that have not been minted will turn light green as you come closer to them. The trail behind you remains and properties in close proximity to the trail are also mintable. In order to mint the light green property, click on the property then "buy".

* 
** 

Collect Troves

Troves represent the output of services, goods, and cultural activity across neighborhoods in the Upland metaverse. Players will have to send themselves to properties with service structures to discover these troves that are integral to minting Uppies.  [Learn more about troves here.](https://upland-guide.com/uppies/troves)

** 
** 

Travel to another city

In order to travel to a different city, you can simply send yourself to any property across the metaverse.  You will be presented with the travel route and complete cost of travel. Watch [this video to learn how to send yourself to a different city.](https://youtu.be/-TYp1M8nbtQ)

** 
** 

Travel to a metaventure, or stadium

In order to purchase Legits or other assets from stores, you will have to send yourself to that specific property.    Learn more about [metaventures](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures).  This may include traveling to a different city if you aren't currently located in that city.  Take a look at the different [NFL stadiums](https://upland-guide.com/upland-legits-nfl/stores-and-stadiums) where you can mint NFLPA Legits, or [soccer stadiums](https://upland-guide.com/upland-legits-main/football-legits/soccer-stadiums).

** 
** 

Find a treasure

title: Visiting Fees and Sends : Upland Guide
text:
Document: Visiting Fees and Sends : Upland Guide
Source: https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/visiting-fees-and-sends

** 
** 

Travel to a metaventure, or stadium

In order to purchase Legits or other assets from stores, you will have to send yourself to that specific property.    Learn more about [metaventures](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures).  This may include traveling to a different city if you aren't currently located in that city.  Take a look at the different [NFL stadiums](https://upland-guide.com/upland-legits-nfl/stores-and-stadiums) where you can mint NFLPA Legits, or [soccer stadiums](https://upland-guide.com/upland-legits-main/football-legits/soccer-stadiums).

** 
** 

Find a treasure

Treasure hunting requires you to send yourself to different properties within the city to look for a treasure, where the reward is UPX, or when there are special promotions, potentially spark can be found as well. Treasure hunting has a time limit and you are required to follow directional clues to find the treasure. There is a learning curve to treasure hunting, and the best way to maximize your earnings is to own many properties spread out throughout the city. Due to the fact that sending yourself to your own property does not cost a fee or a send, you can maximize your earnings and not be worried about using up all your sends looking for it. With a time limit, you have less time to look at other properties to try and determine the one with the cheapest visitor fee. If you are new to treasure hunting, make sure you [read these tips](https://upland-guide.com/top-5-things-to-understand-before-treasure-hunting) before getting started.

** 
** 

Help out a visitor

There are many players who help visitors reach uplander status by paying it forward. Sending yourself to a specific person's property is a way of transferring them UPX, albeit in small quantities. There are players who will send themselves to the same property multiple times to get them closer to uplander status. If you are on the receiving end of this type of help, make sure you maximize your visitor fee. Players also use this as a method of payment for [spark rentals](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions).

The next important thing new players should know about sends is that Visitors should minimize the amount of sends that they use. When your initial goal is reaching 10,000 UPX in net value to reach Uplander status, even spending a small amount of UPX can be a relatively large fee. Players who receive a visit from an Visitor, you do not immediately receive the visitor fee. It is deducted from the Visitors total, but is only transferred to the property owner once the Visitor reached Uplander status. This is one of the reasons I suggest Visitors and Uplanders without lots of UPX value should avoid treasure hunting. Alternatively, if you have time to treasure hunt, Rutherford is an excellent city to get started hunting as its small size lends very well to learning the ropes.

title: Visiting Fees and Sends : Upland Guide
text:
Document: Visiting Fees and Sends : Upland Guide
Source: https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/visiting-fees-and-sends

The next important thing new players should know about sends is that Visitors should minimize the amount of sends that they use. When your initial goal is reaching 10,000 UPX in net value to reach Uplander status, even spending a small amount of UPX can be a relatively large fee. Players who receive a visit from an Visitor, you do not immediately receive the visitor fee. It is deducted from the Visitors total, but is only transferred to the property owner once the Visitor reached Uplander status. This is one of the reasons I suggest Visitors and Uplanders without lots of UPX value should avoid treasure hunting. Alternatively, if you have time to treasure hunt, Rutherford is an excellent city to get started hunting as its small size lends very well to learning the ropes.

Before visiting others, you must understand how your block explorer moves around the city. He always moves in a random direction and leaves a trail behind him. If you want to move in a specific direction you will have to send yourself to a property and hope that your block explorer starts moving in that direction.

Depending on the [tier of the city](https://upland-guide.com/city-tiers-and-vanilla-mode), visiting fees vary. The cities with the cheapest fees like Bakersfield sends cost from 5-25 UPX, whereas in a city like Manhattan, sends are 25-125 UPX.

As of November 2025, players no longer need to collect the paper airplanes to gain sends. You can send yourself an unlimited number of times to properties, given that you still have to pay the visitation fee when landing on a property other than yours.

Below is historic information on how sends were collected, it is no longer useful information for playing Upland.

Upland ensures that players never have less than 3 sends for more than 24 hours. The topic of sends is confusing and it can appear like there is a bug because you may not always be able to reach the maximum number of sends that you can collect for free, which is eleven. For example, if you have 5 sends, waiting 48 hours will not grant you 6 additional sends to get you to the maximum of 11 sends. Below are the different scenarios you can find yourself in and how you can get to your maximum of 11 sends:

- You start the day with any number of sends greater than or equal to 3. After 24 hours you will not receive any sends, as you did not use any of the rechargeable ones. For example, you started the day with 11 sends and you use 5 of them. Since you did not use any of your last 3 rechargeable sends you will not receive 3 new sends after 24 hours. You will have to find paper airplanes to collect more until you reach 11.

title: Visiting Fees and Sends : Upland Guide
text:
Document: Visiting Fees and Sends : Upland Guide
Source: https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/visiting-fees-and-sends

- You start the day with any number of sends greater than or equal to 3. After 24 hours you will not receive any sends, as you did not use any of the rechargeable ones. For example, you started the day with 11 sends and you use 5 of them. Since you did not use any of your last 3 rechargeable sends you will not receive 3 new sends after 24 hours. You will have to find paper airplanes to collect more until you reach 11.

- You start the day with 11 sends and you use 11 of them. After 24 hours you will receive 3 sends. Once you receive your 3 free sends you will need to find paper airplanes to collect more until you reach 11.

- You start the day with 11 sends and you use 10 of them. You then use your last send to collect a paper airplane holding more sends with the goal of reaching 11. You can't collect more than 8 sends. After 24 hours you will receive your 3 rechargeable sends bringing your total to 11.

- You start the day with 11 sends and you use 9 of them. After 24 hours you will receive 1 send, bringing your total to 3. Find paper airplanes to collect more until you reach 11.

In summary, only if you use some or all of the last 3 sends that you have will those be replenished after 24 hours.

There are two ways to get sends - they can be purchased in the Shop at a rate of $0.99 for 10 sends. There is no limit to the number of sends you can purchase, but there is a maximum of 80 sends that can be used in a day.

If you wish to collect sends for free, you must send yourself in range of a paper airplane. Beware that there is a limit of 11 sends that you can hold and collect at any given time for free. You can collect more after some are used, It's important to note that sending yourself to your own property is free and does not use up a send.

# Fundamentals : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals
If you are have just discovered Upland and are getting started, know that there is a learning curve to the game. At first, the game is intriguing as it offers endless possibilities to [play](https://upland-guide.com/entertainment), [earn](https://upland-guide.com/economy), and [connect](https://upland-guide.com/community). Before that you do need to understand the fundamentals of the game and how to play. The Upland Guide [YouTube playlist for new players](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL3zT4OlFr_bkCQcfK0nvKxPVEknHskmen) and the [top 10 mistakes to avoid as a new player](https://upland-guide.com/top-10-mistakes-made-in-upland-metaverse) are the perfect places to start.

The Upland Guide has all the information you need to know starting with our [FAQ](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions)page. Our menu at the top of the page will help you navigate the important aspects of the Metaverse. We also dive into general strategies and detail all the [different ways you can earn](https://upland-guide.com/earning-in-upland) in Upland. Developing a [beginner strategy](https://upland-guide.com/beginner-strategy), [becoming an Uplander](https://upland-guide.com/becoming-an-uplander) and additional strategies to progress to several [statuses](https://upland-guide.com/upland-status)- [pro](https://upland-guide.com/i-am-an-uplander-now-what)and [director](https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/becoming-a-director) are also important milestones you may strive to acheive. We teach you about [real estate](https://upland-guide.com/real-estate) in the Metaverse, how to have a [minting strategy for new city releases](https://upland-guide.com/new-city-release-strategy), how to begin construction with [spark](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/spark) and creating life with [STEM](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/stem).

If you happen to be a sports fan - NFL, soccer, racing, or e-sports, check out [Upland's partners](https://upland-guide.com/about/partners) as a great way to connect to other fans and collect Legits and other collectibles

If you think you are ready to dive into the Metaverse, [test your knowledge by taking our quizzes](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/quiz-home) to make sure you have the basic understanding of the fundamentals before starting. It can prevent you from making mistakes.

Whether it be [cars](https://upland-guide.com/transportation/cars), [Legits](https://upland-guide.com/upland-legits-main), [treasure hunting](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/how-to-treasure-hunt), or other future features, the Upland Guide will be the first to provide you with the important information and tips on how to include this in your Metaverse life and strategy.

# Upland Missions : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/missions
Missions are an exciting way to both play and earn in the Upland Metaverse. For new players, its also a way for players to learn the basics of the Upland Metaverse. For the starter missions, you will be rewarded UPX. We highly recommend completing these starter missions as a new player to earn valuable UPX, but also to better familiarize yourself with the important game mechanics. Follow along with our [free Mission Course](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/missions/beginner-course) to accelerate your learning and find the fastest path to reaching Uplander status.

Upland's mission center can be found in the main menu by clicking the 3 dots at the bottom of the game and click missions. The best place to learn how to navigate the Upland interface and menu bar is [here](https://www.canva.com/design/DAFnJ6bfXCw/9wcXakMaf9_o6KlZsMU_VQ/view?utm_content=DAFnJ6bfXCw&utm_campaign=designshare&utm_medium=link&utm_source=publishsharelink). This is a great tool that can supplement your learning as you complete the missions.

In addition to completing these missions as a new player, your first primary goal is to become an Uplander by reaching a net worth of 10,000 UPX. Beyond the instructions provided during the mission, there are lots of important tips and tricks that you are missing out on. We highly suggest following along the [Upland Guide New Player YouTube Playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL3zT4OlFr_bkCQcfK0nvKxPVEknHskmen) which walks you through all of the important steps left out of the mission tutorials. By [reading up on how to become an Uplander](https://upland-guide.com/becoming-an-uplander), you can help to give meaning to the different starter missions as they help you reach the goal of 10,000 UPX net worth. **Before you reach Uplander status of 10,000 UPX**, if you are brand new to Upland, we offer players chances to win [additional bonuses](https://upland-guide.com/referral-bonus) if you register for Upland with our referral code.

Upland is a platform where you play, earn, and connect. After earning your way to Uplander, learn about [all the different ways you can earn in the metaverse.](https://upland-guide.com/earning-in-upland)All the missions and the amount of UPX you earn are detailed in the table below. We highly recommend checking out out [this link to help you get started](https://upland-guide.com/getting-started) in Upland before completing these mission.

It's important to choose a correct starting city when entering Upland. If you regret your initial choice as part of the "buy a property" mission you have the one time option to choose a new starting city without having to spend UPX and time to travel to it. Watching this video will help you to determine [what starting city might be best for you](https://youtu.be/dbBoTwBsNk0).

Send a chat message - 250 UPX
