** 
** 

Visit 3 metaventures - 500 UPX

Metaventures are player run shops in Upland that are identified on the map with an orange dot.  Visit any 3 metaventures by sending yourself to the property that houses the metaventure.

- The metaventure must be owned by a different player, and not your own

- Sending yourself to an adjacent property that is in range of the metaventure is not enough to qualify.

The Upland Guide has several metaventures all across the metaverse.  If you have assets you are looking to buy or sell, please consider shopping with us.  [Learn more about our shops here.](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/dales-metaventures)

Learn more about the different types of metaventures, and everything you need to know about opening your own metaventure [here](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures).

** 
** 

Buy a property - 300 UPX

Buy a property in Upland. Visitors are only able to mint properties. [Learn how to mint your first property](https://youtu.be/bZizjkz8nEg) in Upland.

In Upland, buying a property often refers to purchasing one from another player, whereas minting one is the act of being the first player to purchase one from Upland.

** 
** 

Complete a collection - 300 UPX

[Learn about completing property collections](https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/collections) and [when is the best time to create the base collections](https://upland-guide.com/collections-strategy)

** 
** 

Collect earnings 5 times - 500 UPX

Property earnings can be collected every 3 hours.  Based on your uplander status, there is a maximum amount of UPX that can be held unclaimed.  [Learn more about these amounts here.](https://upland-guide.com/2023/05/23/uncollected-upx-earning-cap)  Collect your UPX earnings 5 times to get the bonus.  [Learn about all the ways you can earn in Upland.](https://upland-guide.com/earning-in-upland)

*

* 
** 

Start a treasure hunt - 100 UPX

[Learn more about treasure hunting her](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/how-to-treasure-hunt)e.  If you want to have success in your first treasure hunt, make sure you start with and that you likely won't profit off your first few treasure hunts. Make sure to collect additional sends to have the maximum of 11 sends before you start your first hunt.  [Learn more about collecting sends here.](https://upland-guide.com/visiting-fees-and-sends)

Regardless, you get one free treasure hunt each day, so just by starting this treasure hunt and doing nothing else will reward you with this bonus.

** 
** 

Travel to a new city - 400 UPX

Travel to a different Upland city using public transportation.  [Learn more about travelling and how to avoid the most common mistakes.](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/how-to-travel-in-upland)

# Properties : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/getting-started/properties
The future is digital, and Upland Metaverse is leading the charge, building a vibrant world where virtual land holds real value and opens doors to endless possibilities. Owning land in Upland isn't just about owning pixels; it's about staking your claim in a thriving [economy](https://upland-guide.com/economy), a dynamic community, and a platform poised to revolutionize our interaction with the digital world. Your properties are NFTs that you not only own, but also have the ability to sell for UPX or USD.

Properties are the foundation of the metaverse. Its important for every player to own at least one property. After all, you won't want to be homeless in the metaverse. Original base prices of properties can range from as low as 1,000 UPX (where $1=1,000 UPX) and as high as millions of UPX, so there is something for everyone. Furthermore, there are [FSA properties](https://upland-guide.com/fsa-properties) that are exclusively reserved for new players - Visitors and Uplanders who have net worth less than 100,000 UPX. This will ensure that there will always be opportunities for new players to easily obtain land in the metaverse.

Owning properties are an important part of being part of a [community](https://upland-guide.com/community). In this sense, its not so different from the real world. By owning land, you have a vested stake in the community that you live in. The same is true in Upland - here you can also define your permanent residence and help to develop your community, and even [vote](https://upland-guide.com/community/governance-and-voting). You can open your own [metaventure](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures)- player run businesses. If you own a [car](https://upland-guide.com/transportation/cars)or other [map assets](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/outdoor-decor), you will require a property in order to place it. If decorating your home for holidays like Halloween or Christmas is something you do regularly, it can also be done in the metaverse with [structure ornaments](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/ornaments). [You can even create these items yourself!](https://upland-guide.com/creators)

On top of your properties you can build [structures](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/structure-types)with [spark](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/spark), [metaventures](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures), [map assets](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/outdoor-decor) and more. If you want to see what fits on a property, make sure to check out the [playground](https://upland-guide.com/getting-started/properties/metaverse-playground).

Check out [all the cities](https://upland-guide.com/starting-city) you can buy properties in, and [why you might want to own a property in different cities](https://upland-guide.com/do-i-need-a-property-in-each-city).

[Learn more here about minting properties in Upland.](https://upland-guide.com/visiting-fees-and-sends)

# Entering the Metaverse : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/getting-started/starting-city
When you join the Metaverse, you will need to choose your starting city. Ideally, your first task is to mint a property. Minting a property refers to being the first person to purchase the property and creating it on the block chain. As mentioned, your starting city can differ based on your [initial strategy](https://upland-guide.com/beginner-strategy) and the [amount of money](https://upland-guide.com/referral-bonus) you are putting into the game. At any given time, the answer could change. Upland announcements, new in game features, secondary market prices are all dynamic and can have influence on the question *"What city should I start in?"* This page may not have the answer to where you should start, but hopefully it will help you narrow down your choices of where **not** to start. Watch the video below for some additional insight on helping you to define your starting strategy or continue below for the list of cities. Learn about how to mint your first property as part of our [free introductory missions course](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/missions/beginner-course)that will help you earn thousands of UPX on your way to Uplander status.

If you are looking to reach Uplander status by completing missions, [this video](https://youtu.be/yPxKSMZ6CxE?si=sWR5rkpeLhyoP_FC) is a complete guide on how to do this in the most efficient way possible.

Below are the cities in order of their release dates, and their statuses. Feel free to send us a message using the blue button in the bottom right corner with any questions you might have about where is the best place to start right now. Alternatively, feel free to message YK2012 using the in game chat.

If you are joining Upland right before the release of a new city, you should know that new city releases are the best opportunity for you to [grow your net worth](https://upland-guide.com/new-city-release). Upland typically gives up to one weeks notice prior to releasing a new city. There are many announcements leading up to the release, and [this page will help to explain](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/new-city-release-process) that in more details so you can be better prepared.

# Metaventures : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/metaventures
Metaventures, or in game businesses are an important part of Upland and its economy. These metaventures will allow people sell Legits, block explorers, map assets, your own NFT project, and more in the future! The car economy is playing a large part of the metaverse, and in addition to the car showroom and speedway metaventures, there will be many more types of car shops. Learn more about the [vehicle economy in Upland.](https://upland-guide.com/economy/car-economy)

Developers can now integrate 3rd party games, apps, experiences in Upland and contribute to the entrepreneur's metaverse. As a developer (no need to any special knowledge about NFTs or blockchain), you can start creating experiences for Uplanders. [Learn more here.](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/layer-2-dev-shops)

Not every Uplander will likely have the means or desire to open their own metaventure, however they will need a place to list their asset for sale. Players have the ability to become a sub-merchant and list their assets in a store, with the metaventure owner taking a commission (2-10%) on its sale. Read more here about [how to become a sub-merchant](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/sub-merchants)and list your asset in a shop. Check out the [Upland Guide metaventures](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/dales-metaventures), where we offer the lowest commission fees possible. If you do wish to open a shop, learn about the [general registration process here](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/registration-process), or what it takes to manage a business at the bottom of this page. You can also [take our quiz](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/quiz-home/metaventure-quiz) to make sure you know all the basics.

Several different types of metaventures will exist within Upland.  The following table details the different types of metaventures. If you contemplating opening up one of these Metaventures, head over to our [planning page](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/planning-your-metaventure)where we have a guide/checklist that can help you conceptualize your Metaverse business plan. You can also [use the playground](https://upland-guide.com/getting-started/properties/metaverse-playground) to verify if a specific type of structure for a metaventure can fit properly on your property. The best part is this can be tested on any property in the metaverse - not only those that you own.

Metaventure Category Name Description Status

[Block Explorer Shops](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/block-explorer-shops) Reseller of Upland Block Explorers [Available to all](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/block-explorer-shops)

[Racing Legits Shop (Stock Car Pro)](https://upland-guide.com/upland-partnerships/stock-car-pro-series) Reseller of Racing Legits and Power ups [Available to all](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/racing-legits-shop)

[Varity Legits Shop](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/variety-legits-shop) Shops that sell a variety of legits which do not have a dedicated secondary market presence, such as the ones listed above. [See a list of all types of Legits here.](https://upland-guide.com/upland-legits-main) [Available to all](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/variety-legits-shop)

Football (Soccer) Fan Shops Reseller of soccer Legits [Available to all](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/nflpa-legits-fan-shops) (same process as NFLPA shops)

[Factories](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/manufacturing) Manufacture 3D model NFTs to be placed on your properties, such as [map assets](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/outdoor-decor), [Structure ornaments](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/ornaments), or [karts](https://upland-guide.com/entertainment/car-racing/karts). [Available to all](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/manufacturing)

[Showroom - map assets](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/showrooms) Store to sell manufactured goods such as [map assets](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/outdoor-decor), [Structure ornaments](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/ornaments), or [karts](https://upland-guide.com/entertainment/car-racing/karts), and vehicles. beta testing but [Available to all.](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/registration-process) Sub-merchant feature not available.

Racing Academies Ability to rent out block explorers for players to use during [car racing](https://upland-guide.com/entertainment/car-racing) Announced as future type of metaventure

The monthly fees, or venture dues required to maintain a metaventure is based on its type, city it is in and the number of businesses of that type operating simultaneously. As there are more similar metaventures in the same city, the cost to operate a metaventure will increase in order to discourage over saturation of the market. [Click here to understand in more detail the calculation of venture dues.](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/venture-dues)

Upland has stated "Metaventures will mostly be self-regulated, and will require little interference from the Upland team". This makes the Upland Guide Metaverse Directory the ideal place to advertise your metaventure, or to find existing ones operating in your city.

If you are looking to learn more about metaventures, and how you can bring your skills or real world business into the metaverse, [check out the services the Upland Guide provides.](https://upland-guide.com/about/consulting-services)

# Upland Layer 2 - Dev Shops : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/layer-2-dev-shops
The Upland Metaverse is not limited to the experiences that Upland creates. As a create and earn metaverse, anyone has the opportunity to be a contributor to the metaverse. From creating games, to experiences, if you can imagine it, you can do it! Upland has created the [Upland Developer Network (UDN)](https://www.upland.me/events/the-upland-developers-network) and [UDN Pro](https://www.upland.me/events/applications-to-become-a-udnpro-are-now-open)for players to be able to access the community developer tools. These will enable you to integrate your 3rd party tool into Upland. The best part is that there is no web 3.0 or blockchain knowledge required! If you are already a developer - whether it be 2D, 3D, or VR experiences you can get started in Upland right away!

These experiences that you can now create can integrate Upland's assets. You even have the ability to create your own in game assets through [manufacturing](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/manufacturing) and use these in a game that you create. Watch the video below to learn more about Upland Layer 2, and an example of what you can do. The example discussed explains how the Upland metaverse can elevate assets or NFTs created around a specific game, giving its players ownership over the assets used and earned through the game or experience. [NFT token gating](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/layer-2-dev-shops/nft-token-gating) has never been easier with the Upland Metaverse.

If you are a developer, and new to the Metaverse, you can [learn how YK2012 and the Upland Guide can help to get you](https://upland-guide.com/about/consulting-services) started about learning about Upland, and how to best implement your game/experience within the Metaverse.

# Nursery Metaventures : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/nursery
Looking to build a garden or add greenery to your Upland property? Nursery metaventures are the first step in this important stage of adding life to the Upland metaverse

Looking to build a garden or add greenery to your Upland property? Nursery metaventures are the first step in this important stage of adding [life](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/life)to the Upland metaverse. Nurseries facilitate the buying and selling of “[Seed Legits](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/upland-legits/seed-legits)”. You can trade your seed Legit for an [ornamental plant](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/ornamental-plants) by burning the Legit. Once planted, the living element will become not non-tradable.[Care for the wellbeing](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/ornamental-plants/health-and-wellbeing) of the plant as it grows and evolves over time. Be careful, because without proper care and feeding of [STEM](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/stem), they will wither away and die.

Any player can open a Nursery, but players who place a totem on their Nursery will unlock additional utility for their metaventure. These upgraded Nurseries will enable players to spend Sparklet in exchange for a random seed Legit. The owner of the nursery will receive 5% of the value of the [sparklet](https://upland-guide.com/economy/sparklet)spent in UPX as commission for facilitating the legit generation. Generating seed legits from your own metaventure will not give you any UPX commission. The scarcity of these upgraded Nurseries will reward those who own and strategically activate totems on that property.

Seed types will vary in rarity and availability based on location. For example, Palm Trees may be exclusive to Nurseries in cities like Miami and Los Angeles, while Pine Trees could be found only in Lake Tahoe or Park City. This adds a unique geographical layer to plant discovery and trade, enhancing the connection between Life and the Upland map. The only type of seeds that are not generated at nurseries are [grass and sod](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/ornamental-plants/grass-and-sod), which can be purchased from the Upland store.

To get started, go to the [Upland store](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/upland-upx-store)and purchase the nursery structure for 50,000 UPX. Like a [service structure](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/structure-types/service-structures), this model will be available in your account to build on any property it fits. You can build as many as you want. The nursery also has a 3.7 employment units meaning that in the future you will be able to [employ your uppies](https://upland-guide.com/uppies/employing-uppies) at the nursery and increase your [influence score](https://upland-guide.com/uppies/influence-score). Alternatively to purchasing the structure, you can utilize the [construction hub](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/structure-types/construction-hub) to outsource the start of construction if you don't plan on building many nurseries.

Get stared with gardening, and read more about the [Upland Guide's 5 Steps to Thriving at gardening.](https://open.substack.com/pub/uplandguide/p/the-ultimate-guide-to-gardening-in-the-metaverse)

[Learn about the pros and cons of opening a nursery in this video.](https://youtu.be/JIW8T6rNhpo)

# Upland Seasons : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/metaverse-seasons
The Upland metaverse revolves around 6 seasons, each lasting 6 weeks. During each season there are several different scheduled sales and activities to partake in, giving you opportunities to purchase and win exclusive items like [badges](https://upland-guide.com/community/3d-avatar-identity/upland-badges), UPX, [Sparklet](https://upland-guide.com/economy/sparklet), [Lore Legits](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/upland-legits/lore) and more. The following is a list of the different seasons and dates in Upland:

*

Below is a list of different activities and competitions to partake in during each season. The very first season in Upland was the 2024 Frost season. Each season has activities that shine a spotlight on a specific city. To learn more about the active season, visit the [gamified earnings page.](https://upland-guide.com/economy/gamified-upx-earnings)

* 
** 

Gamified UPX Earnings

During each season you have an opportunity to influence the amount of yield you earn for the following season.  UPX earnings are set at a base of 4.9% but you have the ability to increase that to 15.19% by completing a number of tasks.  Learn how to ensure you can [maximize your earnings here.](https://upland-guide.com/economy/gamified-upx-earnings)

(Don't forget to collect your earnings before the start of a new season, [learn why here).](https://upland-guide.com/economy/gamified-upx-earnings/collecting-upx-earnings)

** 
** 

Builders Score Contest

Players compete in tasks related to building with Sparklet in order to increase their building score throughout each season.  [Learn more about this contest here.](https://upland-guide.com/metaverse-seasons/builder-score)

** 
** 

Collection Score Contest

Players compete to collect [Block Explorers](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/block-explorers), [City Passes](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/new-city-release-process/city-pass), [Season Passes](https://upland-guide.com/metaverse-seasons/season-pass), and [Badges](https://upland-guide.com/community/3d-avatar-identity/upland-badges) released during the current season.  At the end of each season, prizes are awarded to the top players.

[Learn more about collection scores and how they are calculated here.](https://upland-guide.com/metaverse-seasons/collectors-score)

** 
** 

Property Decor Contest

Decorate your property according to the season theme for your chance to show off your design skills and stand out as a model home designer in the metaverse.  [Learn more here.](https://upland-guide.com/metaverse-seasons/property-decor-contest)

** 
** 

Neighborhood Collection Challenge

Each season, neighborhoods compete in challenges to spawn a new neighborhood collection.

All neighborhoods who have previously spawned this new collection are competing to further increase their collection earning boost and level up their connection to even an **ultra rare **collection!

[Learn more about these competitions here.](https://upland-guide.com/community/neighborhood-ratings)

** 
** 

Cosmetic Items and Season Passes

Season passes are for players who appreciate style and cosmetics. Burning a pass during rewards you with a badge as well as a variety of cosmetic items that give you freedom to tailor your in-game identity. Whether you favor a discreet appearance or wish to make a bold impression, these cosmetics offer a platform to exhibit your distinct style.  [Learn more about these passes and the cosmetic items here.](https://upland-guide.com/metaverse-seasons/season-pass)

** 
** 

Decorate your home with structure ornaments

You can decorate your home with any structure ornament year round, but by decorating it with an ornament corresponding to the current season you are participating in special seasonal challenges where you can win prizes

- [seasonal ornament challenge](https://upland-guide.com/metaverse-seasons/season-ornament-challenge)

- [Seasonal builders score challenge](https://upland-guide.com/metaverse-seasons/builder-score)

[Learn more about structure ornaments here.](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/ornaments)

[Learn how to decorate your home here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MR6kMMg_kEY).

** 
** 

Go Kart Challenge

# Transportation : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/transportation
Just like the real world, the Upland Metaverse has different cities and their own way of travelling between and within them. Upland is creating a Metaverse mapped over the real world, so it makes sense to have certain rules as to how one can travel. In Upland, taking a plane is faster than a train, but it will cost more. This is something that makes logical sense. In addition to that, not every city is accessible from each other. This can add an element of confusion as trying to find your way around has confused many players in the past. The Upland Guide is here to teach you and guide you through everything you need to know about transportation and travelling within the Metaverse. Learn [how to travel between cities](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/how-to-travel-in-upland) and [learn about sends and travelling within a city](https://upland-guide.com/visiting-fees-and-sends). Our [transportation YouTube playlist](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL3zT4OlFr_bkcn-1pF_72mSRuddsNbR31) has all the videos you need to get started with travelling.

The different modes of transportation are as follows:

- **Plane** (public) - The fastest but most expensive option to travel. All major cities, and some intermediate ones have airports.

- **Plane** (private) - Players have the ability to own their own private aircraft that will help to connect cities that do not have public airports together. [Learn more about private aircraft here.](https://upland-guide.com/transportation/private-transportation/private-aviation)

- **Boats **- These vehicles are used to fish for [troves](https://upland-guide.com/uppies/troves)in open waters. [Learn more about boats here.](https://upland-guide.com/transportation/boats)

- **Train** - A slower option compared to planes, but more affordable. Major and intermediate cities have train terminals. Some of the smaller cities also have trains connecting them.

- **Bus **- A cheap transportation option that connects cities that are in close proximity to one another.

- **Hyperloop** - A very fast and expensive travel option. This is owned by [Hyperloop TT](http://www.hyperlooptt.com) and is constructed on the actual route that will hyperloop will take. It currently connects Chicago to Cleveland. You can watch our video that describes [what exactly the hyperloop is](https://youtu.be/kl9a5FJPryM)here.

- **Cars** - Cars provide players a [private option to travel](https://upland-guide.com/transportation/private-transportation) to transport both people and cargo between cities. The transportation of cargo will also be done via the different car models. In addition, although it isn't exactly considered transportation but car racing will clearly also require the player to possess a car. Learn [more about cars here](https://upland-guide.com/transportation/cars) or follow us on our [YouTube playlist.](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL3zT4OlFr_blGdQKlF10UEnSNurwXpSZE)

Within Upland there are some specific properties aside from transportation terminals that are important to note and are frequently visited by Uplanders:

- **NFL Stadiums** - In order to mint [NFLPA Legits](https://upland-guide.com/upland-legits-nfl), you must travel to the stadium or NFLPA shop. Here is a list of all the [stadium addresses](https://upland-guide.com/upland-legits-nfl/stores-and-stadiums).

- [Charging Stations](https://upland-guide.com/transportation/charging-stations) - Properties in yet to be released cities where you can stop to charge your vehicle on a long road trip.

# Intro to Cars : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/transportation/cars
The introduction of cars to the metaverse creates a wide spectrum of additional ways to develop the metaverse, provide both social and monetary value to Uplanders and all people or entities within the metaverse. Just like in the real world, there is a process to create cars or other goods and this is [manufacturing](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/manufacturing). Cars and all non living items in the metaverse will be manufactured using spark in manufacturing plants and sold within specific [metaventures](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures)called showrooms. The first car brand in Upland is their own brand M-Motors. It's manufacturing plant is located at 4220 Network Circle, Santa Clara, California.

As an Uplander, it may be important for you to own a car as it will provide important utility within Upland. Once real time movement will be introduced, something like a car will be extremely important to get around quickly. Just like in the real world, if you don't have a car you will depend on others - public transportation, ride sharing, Ubers or taxi services. This could become critical if you want to purchase something from a store and you want to get there quickly because you think someone might purchase it first. A personal car can enable you the flexibility to travel where you want and when you want. Beyond travelling within a city, Upland has announced that there will be cities that are only accessible by car. Here I go into more detail about why you need a car in Upland.

In addition to the future practical need to own a vehicle, you can also have fun racing one. Both cars and [karts](https://upland-guide.com/entertainment/car-racing/karts)can be used in racing, where you can compete with your friends and even [earn UPX for winning races](https://upland-guide.com/entertainment/car-racing/racing-for-stakes). Learn more about [car racing here](https://upland-guide.com/entertainment/car-racing).

Another question arises as to how manufactured goods will be transported to the showrooms that will sell them to the end customer?

Upland has introduced six different types of cars that will have different utilities in the metaverse. The six types are sedan, sports car, SUV, pick up truck, van , and semi-trailer. We also know that in the future, your car will be powered by spark. A second element to cars will be car racing, where players will be able to [create speedway metaventure racetracks](https://upland-guide.com/metaventures/speedway-racetrack) and host races where other Uplanders to win prizes. # MV-Motors Cars : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/transportation/cars/mv-motors-cars
The first car brand to enter the Metaverse is Upland's MV-Motors. These cars are produced at 4220 Network Circle in Santa Clara, California. Cars are required not only for [racing](https://upland-guide.com/entertainment/car-racing), but also for [travelling between cities](https://upland-guide.com/transportation/private-transportation).

*

There are also cities that are only accessible by car, the first being Lake Tahoe. This mode of transportation will be important as both people and goods will need to be transported.

Below is a list of the types of MV Motor vehicles.

* 
** 

Race car

*

Racing will be the first fully immersive Unity-based experience in the Upland metaverse,allowing players to compete with each other in both Upland-Sponsored and Player-Generated races. You will be able to race with any type of car, but race cars will most likely be the most expensive type of car, and have driving abilities that fit racetracks that have long straight away thus optimizing for speed and acceleration.

* 
** 

SUV

*
SUVs might be the perfect hybrid between a sedan and a race car.  It may be able to transport smaller cargo, or it may even have some favourable abilities within racing.  It might be the best car option if you are looking for versatility in the Metaverse.

* 
** 

Sedan

*

Cars will be used as a means of transportation both between cities and within cities in Upland. Much like the real world, some cities in Upland will only be accessible via cars.

* 
** 

Semi-trailer

* Semi-trailers will primarily be used to transport lorge manufactured goods from the manufacturing plant to the showrooms.  Its possible that in addition to using vans and pick up trucks, these semi trailers will also be used to transport goods that Uplanders purchase from a showrooms to their homes.

* 
** 

Minivan

*

If you don't own a car in Upland, you will be able to use a ride share service where other Uplanders will take you to your destination for a fee.  This type of vehicle may also be used to transport goods. If you are in a different city and don't want to travel to pick up something that you purchased from a store, you might be able to enlist another player to purchase it and deliver it to you or your house.

* 
** 

Pickup truck

This type of vehicle will likely be used to transport goods or cargo. If you are in a different city and don't want to travel to pick up something that you purchased from a store, you might be able to enlist another player to purchase it and deliver it to you or your house.  If you purchased something large like a piece of outdoor decor, you may need a large vehicle like a pickup truck to deliver it to your property.

The easiest way to become an uplander is to spend the minimum amount of money and buy UPX (5 USD). Once you complete the following steps you will become an uplander.

** **

* There are certain referral codes, like ours that provide you with an additional 50% bonus on your first UPX purchase (up to $100). In the case you did use a referral bonus, you would receive 7,500 UPX.  Before deciding to spend the $5, the *Upland Guide* offers [other promotions](https://upland-guide.com/referral-bonus) when using our referral code. It is worth checking those out before signing up. It's nice to get a 50% bonus on $5, but if you are willing to spend more you are still eligible to receive that same 50% bonus (up to a $100 purchase of UPX!) The Upland Guide also offers additional benefits when using our referral code.

** 
** 

Complete Upland starter Missions

To help you learn how to play Upland, they have created a number of [starter missions](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/missions) that you can complete that as a visitor to help you learn the game and earn up to 3,750 UPX to get you closer to to the 10,000 UPX thresh hold to become an Uplander.  (Note that as you complete those missions there are tasks that have costs associated with them).

In addition to completing these missions, as a new player you get your daily bonus during the first 21 days of playing. This period is divided into 3 streaks of 7 days each. If you login to the game every 24 hours without breaking this interval (meaning not earlier) you will receive your daily bonus, which increases every day. If you break the 7 day login streak, your daily bonus will not increase daily and it's amount will be decreased to the one you received your very first day. The days limit remains the same - 21 days.

If you become an Uplander and break the rule mentioned above, you will be able to finish the current streak, but won't be able to start a new one. This means the 21 day period may be shortened for some users.

[Watch this video to learn the best way to complete all these tasks in order to reach Uplander status.](https://youtu.be/yPxKSMZ6CxE?si=sWR5rkpeLhyoP_FC)

If after completing all the steps mentioned above and you have yet to reach Uplander status, you can also ask people for visits. The maximum visit fee varies depending on the city. The highest fee in the game is 125 UPX. Head over to the [official Upland discord server](https://discord.gg/rTcdta6wSt) to ask for visits in the #visits channel. Start engaging in the community and hopefully people will give you some visits. This process could take quite a number of days depending on how much time you invest in this. This, in combination with logging in every day for 21 straight days should be able to get you to Uplander status.

We do not suggest this method of reaching upland for 3 main reasons.

- We value your time. The following may not be true for everyone and this is a generalization for the masses. We believe that the time you will need to spend asking for visits and completing all the missions is worth more than $5.  Once you get going in Upland you are bound to complete all the missions and earn that UPX.  The question is how much time do you want to invest at the beginning to complete the tasks while potentially missing out on [extra bonuses](https://upland-guide.com/referral-bonus).

- Always collect your daily bonus, but when this is your primary growth strategy you are missing out on other opportunities. A lot can happen in three weeks in Upland. You may not want to watch from the sidelines as the game continues to run forward as you slowly pick up daily bonuses.

- Once you reach uplander status, your growth will also likely be very slow. If the properties you bought were the cheapest ones, but not in a desired neighborhood, you may be stuck with them without the ability to sell. This would bring you back to square one - properties that nobody want and no UPX. This will likely lead you to do the following - invest money to buy more properties, sell for a loss, or get frustrated and abandon the game.

- Buying UPX and using the [referral code](https://upland-guide.com/referral-bonus) gives you a great bonus (additional 50%) on your initial $5 or any amount you decide to invest. The best way to achieve accelerated growth is by starting off by buying your way to uplander status - even if it is only $5.

The best way to achieve accelerated growth is by starting off by buying your way to uplander status - even if it is only $5.

** 
** 

Treasure Hunting

Treasure hunting can be rewarding but it is also risky, especially as a new player. This involves sending yourself to properties around the city looking for a treasure. Treasure hunting has a learning curve, and it is possible to lose UPX on it as you learn and improve at it. Sending yourself to other properties involves using up a send a paying the visitor fee, and for this reason treasure hunting is best when you own a large network of properties scattered across a city because you do not have to pay a visitors fee or use a visit when sending yourself to your own property. Read more about sends and travelling [here](https://upland-guide.com/visiting-fees-and-sends).

You can treasure hunt for free once per 24 hour period. If you find a treasure, you will win UPX. There is even a small chance you might win [spark](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/spark). If you do win spark, you will not receive it immediately. As a visitor, you will have until the upcoming Tuesday to level up to Uplander, otherwise you forfeit the spark reward. Some treasures have more UPX in them than others, so it is possible that even if you find a treasure you could be at a net loss due to your send costs.

If you are able to master treasure hunting quickly it is possible to win your way to uplander status. Before you start, we recommend reading our [top 5 things to understand before treasure hunting](https://upland-guide.com/top-5-things-to-understand-before-treasure-hunting) before getting started.  Also note that that treasure hunting is currently only available using the app and not the browser version of Upland.

If you find these basic and general methods not relevant to your initial starting point in the Metaverse, we offer professional portfolio consultations to help you get started your way. [Learn more about the consulting services we provide here.](https://upland-guide.com/about/consulting-services)

# Collections Strategy : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/collections-strategy
This page will detail for new players the strategy behind when and how to go after these collections and how to manage them to maximize your earnings. Learn more about the [other types of collections here](https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/collections). Check out this [YouTube video](https://youtu.be/2asuJCIDuo8) to learn how to add properties to a collection. This strategy is most relevant for people who are playing for free, or have put in less than 20$ into the game.

A great way to earn more UPX is to complete collections and receive the bonuses that come in two forms.

- Collection bonus - a one time bonus for acquiring the properties that are required to fill the collection. This bonus is only paid out after holding the collection for a [minimum amount of time based on the collection rarity](https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/collections).

- Earnings boost - a yield percentage boost which you receive as long as you have the set of properties actively held in the collection. For example, if you have a property that has a monthly earnings of 1000 UPX and it is part of a collection that has a 1.5X boost, this property will earn 1500 UPX per month

The first collections you will attempt to fill, and the easiest are as follows:

- **[Newbie](https://upland-guide.com/)**- own one property in Upland. You receive an 800 UPX bonus, and a 1.1x boost.

- **[King of the Street](https://upland-guide.com/)** - own three properties on the same street. You receive an 950 UPX bonus, and a 1.3x boost.

- **[City Pro](https://upland-guide.com/)** - own 5 properties in the same city. You receive an 1200 UPX bonus, and a 1.4x boost.

- **[Base City Specific](https://upland-guide.com/)** - own 3 properties in (specific city). You receive approximately 650 UPX bonus, and the boost varies based on the city.

Document: Collections Strategy : Upland Guide

## Newbie

Once you buy your first property, complete this immediately. As you purchase larger (higher mint value) properties make sure to update this collection with that property. Maximizing your boosts will provide you with more UPX. It may not seem like much at the beginning, but it grows as your net worth enlarges and you put larger properties in this collection.

title: Collections Strategy : Upland Guide
text:
Document: Collections Strategy : Upland Guide
Source: https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/collections-strategy

## King of the Street

Completing this collection is also simple, but there is a right and a wrong time to do so. Just like the Newbie collection, as your net worth grows and you are able to purchase larger properties, you will be updating this collection as well. As a beginner, it may be enticing to get the initial bonus, but once you complete the collection, you might want to try and sell the property for a profit. If you are not confident that you can sell that property for a good return or in a short period of time, it might be worth waiting for the [next city release](https://upland-guide.com/new-city-release).

Consider completing this collection with at least 1 non FSA property. There are two restrictions on FSA properties that could place you in an undesirable position regarding this collection. Firstly, you can only mint 3 FSA properties each day. If you are looking to complete this collection by minting during a new city release in high demand areas, you might find that other players will mint properties around you, leaving you with the inability to complete the collection. Secondly, you can only sell 2 FSA properties each week. If you do manage to complete the collection, with the goal of selling the properties, know that it can't be done immediately. There are additional FSA restrictions that you can read about [here](https://upland-guide.com/fsa-properties).

If you are participating in a new city release, it could be more profitable to mint even one property in a high demand neighborhood and delay creating the king of the street collection instead of targeting an area that you have a high probability of being able to complete the collection. Remember that this collection is easy to create, and can be done in any city. There is no need to rush into it at the risk of owning properties that can't be easily sold (if that is your main purpose of completing the collection early).

title: Collections Strategy : Upland Guide
text:
Document: Collections Strategy : Upland Guide
Source: https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/collections-strategy

## Base City Specific

If you don't have the funds or you are stretching your funds to make this collection, don't. This likely means that you have joined Upland at a time where the majority of inexpensive and in demand properties are already owned. It's always good to have some UPX available for the upcoming city release. There isn't an abundance of notice (approximately 1 week) before new cities are released. You will want to have enough UPX to mint a number of cheap properties during that release. Once you have earned enough UPX, you can always buy properties on the secondary market to complete other base city collections. By over extending yourself early, you are missing out on future opportunities. You may find yourself in a situation where a new city is being released and you say to yourself "I wish I hadn't bought that last property. Now I don't have enough UPX to mint properties in the next city."

title: Collections Strategy : Upland Guide
text:
Document: Collections Strategy : Upland Guide
Source: https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/collections-strategy

## City Pro

As a new player who does not put money into the game, owning 5 properties in the same city can seem like a daunting task. If you join Upland and participate in the release of a city, there are plenty inexpensive properties to purchase, some even under 2000 UPX (depending on the city tier). It is possible that you can complete the newbie, king of the street, and city pro collections, but it will take you at least 24 hours. You are only able to mint 3 FSA properties each day. Its possible that by the second day, all of the cheap properties have already been minted. On the other hand, if you miss the release of the city, and the cheapest properties available to mint are not so cheap, your growth rate can be much slower, and the ability to own 5 properties without investing outside money can be difficult. New cities are being released frequently and not always with a lot of notice. It is a good strategy to always have some UPX available so that you are able to participate in the next city release. Don't feel the need to put all your efforts into the city that you start in. Watch [this video](https://youtu.be/LLPTkwiW8GQ) to learn more about the new city release process.

As your net worth continues to grow and you start to gain more and more properties in newly released cities, you will most likely also be able to purchase more expensive properties. As you grow, you will likely also be updating the city pro collection with the latest city such that you get larger boosts to your yield. Be patient with completing this collection.

If you are just joining the game, consider reading more about collections in the [new city release](https://upland-guide.com/new-city-release) and [vanilla mode](https://upland-guide.com/city-tiers-and-vanilla-mode) pages.

# Do I need a property in each city? : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/do-i-need-a-property-in-each-city
So you just joined Upland and you want to own a piece of Times Square in Manhattan, or some prime real estate in the Magnificent Mile in Chicago. Sorry to break it to you, but unless you have thousands of dollars to spend on it, you are out of luck. Many cities have already been released and completely sold out too!

Manhattan and San Francisco were two of the first cities released in the game and due to that fact, as well as the cities being recognized and famous around the world they are in high demand. One of the basic fundamentals of economics is supply and demand. When the supply is low and the demand is high prices go up. So yes, chances are you want to have properties in every city in Upland, but its probably not going to happen right away. The question is how do you get to the point where you can afford to buy the least expensive property in Manhattan (40,000 UPX as of September 2, 2021) as well as in all other cities that have sold out?

Imagine this scenario - you live in Chicago, but your favorite band is playing in Manhattan, and you want to go see them play. You need to drive to the airport, and take a flight to Manhattan. From there you need a place to stay a few night. While you are there you might want to do some sightseeing or buy a few gifts you can't get back home. The same will be true in the Upland Metaverse! Yes, cars, stores, and renting homes will all come to Upland in due time. So wouldn't it be nice to have to own a property with a townhouse right around the corner from Madison Square Gardens? You can rent it out while your primary residence is in Chicago, or turn it into a store that sells unique NFTs that highlight what makes Manhattan awesome. Just like in the real world not everyone could afford this, and the same is true in the Upland Metaverse, but it would be a good idea.

Unless you are investing a lot of money into Upland, its not going to happen overnight.

title: Do I need a property in each city? : Upland Guide
text:
Document: Do I need a property in each city? : Upland Guide
Source: https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/do-i-need-a-property-in-each-city

Unless you are investing a lot of money into Upland, its not going to happen overnight.

Start small; buy low and sell high. It sounds easy, but it can take time and it might not always work out. Upland is a busy place and there is always a lot going on. Just because people are buying and selling properties today doesn't mean that you should. You need to have a strategy. You don't know what other people's strategy is so don't feel the need to actively buy and sell if it isn't right for you. As a newbie, you should focus most on minting properties as opposed to buying on the secondary market. The best place to start exponential growth is by being an uplander during a [new city release](https://upland-guide.com/new-city-release). Your best chance to sell properties for a big markup is by minting collection properties. Even if the city is released in [vanilla mode](https://upland-guide.com/city-tiers-and-vanilla-mode), there are lots of opportunities for this.

If you manage to mint some special properties you want to hold on to that's great. Holding them for a medium to long term can pay off. You do need to balance that with the fact that there might be other properties that you are missing out on minting because you don't have enough UPX. If you aren't willing to invest additional money into the game, you really have to be conscious how you juggle these two strategies. Selling properties in high demand quickly can provide you with that UPX so you can mint more. Be wary that not all your properties may sell. When minting new properties as part of a new city release it can be quite easy to get carried away and spend every last UPX. Don't do that. Always have some extra UPX on hand just in case you find a property for a great deal on the secondary market. If you are minting FSA properties, make sure to be conscience of their [restrictions](https://upland-guide.com/fsa-properties)- you can have too much of a good thing.

After you sell some of your properties for a nice profit, you may want to hold off and wait for the next city release in order to repeat the same process as before. Minting properties also helps to grow your earnings. Each property pays you 17.28% annually based on the mint price. This is paid out on a 3 hour basis. Minting a property provides better earnings than if you were to buy that same property on the secondary market. Also don't forget to take into account that when buying a property on the secondary market you pay an additional 5% transaction fee. For this reason it is recommended to primarily mint properties as you are trying to grow your net worth.

Upland doesn't release a timeline of when new cities will be released, and for this reason its important to always be ready with UPX available. On the other hand, if you do plan on regularly investing USD or crypto into the game, we suggest setting a monthly budget. It can be easy to spend more than what you wanted. If you get to the point where you are comfortable knowing you have enough UPX available to participate in a new city release if it were to happen tomorrow, you can start buying properties on the secondary market in cities that were previously released and are sold out. Maybe you are looking to hold on to it, or maybe you think you can sell it for more in two weeks from now.

Use a site like [upx.world](http://upx.world) to look up prices on the secondary market. Take a look at the city floor prices and markups. If you are just looking to break in at the minimum price, don't disregard the markup. As you can see below, the markup on 1509 E 94th St. is lower than that of 902 Jerome St. meaning that between the two properties, E 94th St. is a better deal. If you can't afford to spend the additional UPX for that property, chances are you aren't ready to be buying into that city. There are several other reasons why one might prefer to buy the Jerome St. property despite the larger markup, but that is not the topic of this page. By choosing the property with a lower markup, you are ensuring that you are getting a better value on your earnings.

As you feel comfortable you can continue to buy into these new cities. For each city, there is a general collection where if you own 3 properties in that city you receive an earnings boost. Try to go for 3 properties in that city in order to get the one time collection reward and start earning a boost on the 3 properties you own.

# I am an Uplander, now what? : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/i-am-an-uplander-now-what
Now that you are an Uplander, you are able to list your properties for sale. You also don't have to worry about renewing your visa. The digital assets are now yours, as Upland has created a wallet for you on the EOS block chain to store all your assets (properties, structures, block explorers). The strategy you use to get to pro is different based on how you get to Uplander:

- [Purchased $50 worth of UPX with the Upland Guide referral code.](https://upland-guide.com/)
- [Purchased $50 worth of UPX without the Upland guide referral code.](https://upland-guide.com/)

# New City Release Strategy : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/new-city-release-strategy
If you are new to Upland, new city releases are exciting, and in Dale the Llama's opinion the best part of the game! Imagine having the ability to buy your favorite property - a downtown skyscraper, your favorite restaurant or bar, a big mall, etc. You just have to get there first! It is a race!

Even if you are a brand new player who has reached Uplander status (less than 100,000 UPX net worth) you have a unique opportunity to start off with fast growth during a new city release by minting FSA properties. New players who have invested more than 100,000 UPX and reached pro level have not need to worry. There are more than enough quality properties to mint that are not FSA. The number of FSA properties in a city vary from around 15%-70%, where only in beginner cities are the amount of FSA properties more than 33%. This post will go into detail the different strategy for new players who have never participated in a city release - what to expect, and how to set yourself up for growth!

Whatever your strategy is, make sure to [avoid these common mistakes](https://upland-guide.com/top-mistakes-new-city-release) during a new city launch! Also, make sure you [take our quiz](https://upland-guide.com/fundamentals/quiz-home/new-city-release-quiz) to make sure you are adequately prepared. Dale recommends reading this page that describes the entire [new city release process](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/new-city-release-process) and clarifies a number of frequently asked questions about the topic before moving forward. If this is your first city release, make sure to learn [how to prepare for it](https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/new-city-release-strategy/preparing-for-a-new-city).

A few basic things to know beforehand:

- [FSA properties (Fair Start Act).](https://upland-guide.com/fsa-properties) This can be a double edged sword. On one hand, it is in place so that new players have an equal opportunity to buy properties all over the map, including collections. These are properties that the big whales can't buy, but many are willing to pay higher markups for collection FSA properties. The downside of FSA properties is that you may only sell 2 of them per calendar week, and holds true even after you pass the 100,000 net worth and make it to a pro. [Click here](https://upland-guide.com/fsa-properties) to read more about these properties. You can only mint 3 FSA properties each day, and a total of 10 over your lifetime. These restrictions make it difficult to amass a large amount of valuable FSA properties, and selling them off will also take several weeks.

Vanilla mode means that these collections are only revealed after the city has been released, and the properties in that neighborhood have been minted. This makes the release more interesting as you must familiarize yourself with the city and guess as to where collections might be. [Read more about vanilla releases here](https://upland-guide.com/city-tiers-and-vanilla-mode), and read our [top 5 reasons why we prefer vanilla releases](https://upland-guide.com/top-5-reasons-we-love-vanilla-releases).

- You must have reached uplander status (10,000 UPX net worth ($10)) in order to sell properties. The easiest way to become an uplander is to buy UPX. For the average player, the best value to set you up for fast growth during a new city release would be to take advantage of the [best starter value](https://upland-guide.com/referral-bonus) promotion when creating your Upland account.

- Watch this video for more insight from YK2012. As an Executive he has participated in over 20 city releases.

The following strategies are primarily for players with a net worth of less than 100,000 UPX. Don't focus on FSA properties

Document: New City Release Strategy : Upland Guide
Source: https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/new-city-release-strategy

** 
** 

Don't focus on FSA properties

Don't focus solely on FSA properties.  With a limit of minting 3 every day, and the best properties being minted within the first few minutes of a city release, there isn't necessarily a huge advantage in being able to mint FSA properties.  Focus on minting properties you want, and if it happens to be an FSA property - great.  If you happen to miss out on the city release by a few hours, this limit to minting FSA properties will likely mean that there will still be properties available for you to mint.

** 
** 

Mint FSA properties in popular neighborhoods

Uplanders and Visitors are the only players who can mint FSA properties.  Another restriction is that a player can only mint 3 FSA properties each day.  During a new city release new players must strategize over what FSA properties they wish to attempt to mint. Neighborhoods that have the largest base price (and therefore likely the fewest number of FSA properties) likely indicate that the neighborhood is a popular place in real life, and that it will be in high demand in Upland as well.  There is a high chance that these neighborhoods also will sell out quite quickly, and prices might rise as there might be a high demand for them.  There might be speculation that this neighborhood might be a future collection.  If you are able to mint a cheap FSA property in this neighborhood you may be able to sell for a nice profit.  (It is likely that visitors won't have enough UPX to mint properties in the most sought after neighborhoods due to the large base prices).  Learn more about these base prices and [understanding the property card.](https://upland-guide.com/property-card)

If you are able to mint 3 FSA properties in such a neighborhood, this may be the best way to ensure fast growth.  If you have sufficient UPX to be able to mint several properties in such a neighborhood, it may make sense to target non-FSA properties first, as there are no restrictions on how many you can mint and sell.  For this reason, we recommend recommend starting with the most amount of UPX possible while remaining under 100,000 UPX.  (see the [best value bonus](https://upland-guide.com/referral-bonus) when signing up for Upland with the Upland Guide).

If you had limited supply of UPX but still managed to get a valuable property, you can try to sell it for a nice fast profit enabling you to mint more properties if you choose.

** 
** 

Become an FSA seller

If you had limited supply of UPX but still managed to get a valuable property, you can try to sell it for a nice fast profit enabling you to mint more properties if you choose.

** 
** 

Become an FSA seller

If you have a limited amount of UPX, and you won't be able to best capitalize on the method above, there are lots of players who are interested in purchasing specific properties that they are unable to due to the fact that they are FSA properties. The reasoning behind this is that some players are looking to purchase entire streets or neighborhoods. They will have to buy those FSA properties on the secondary market. Join the Upland discord server to search out these FSA buyers. Even before the city is released, there is opportunities for you to make a guaranteed sale. Negotiate a sale price on a specific property that they are looking to buy. This ensures that you make a sale before buying the property. It's best to negotiate for larger properties because there is a restriction of FSA property sales. Only 2 FSA properties can be sold each calendar week (resets at 12AM Monday UTC), and you can only mint 3 daily. Read more about the reasoning [why a player would want to buy an FSA property](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/fsa-properties/selling-fsa) on the secondary market.

** 
** 

Play the floor

When a new city is released, players often target to mint the smallest, and cheapest properties first.

When people search for properties in a specific neighborhood, many are looking to buy the cheapest property. These small properties might have the cheapest resale value, however they may have the largest markup. If the collections are known prior to release, it is best to find such areas in collection neighborhoods, as the markup there will be much higher. For this strategy it is best to have maximum liquidity without going over 100,000 UPX, as you will be unable to purchase FSA properties once you reach that threshold. If you have yet to sign up for upland, do so while taking advantage of the [best starter value promotion](https://upland-guide.com/referral-bonus) you will be able to maximize the number of properties you can mint. Depending on the city, it can be possible to mint over 40 properties with this method.

Set up treasure hunting network

Hybrid

[Collections](https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/collections):

# Preparing for a New City Release : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/new-city-release-strategy/preparing-for-a-new-city
Upland new city releases are really exciting. You have the opportunity to mint just about any property you can think of. Whether it be your favorite restaurant, childhood home, a downtown museum the options are endless. Whether you are a collector, holder, or flipper there are infinite opportunities during these releases. In addition to this, it is the best time to [grow your net worth](https://upland-guide.com/new-city-release).

There are two types of city releases - regular and [vanilla](https://upland-guide.com/city-tiers-and-vanilla-mode). The difference being that in vanilla mode, the [collection properties](https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/collections) are not immediately known, but are revealed about one week after the release. Read here about [what we think makes vanilla releases more fun and interesting](https://upland-guide.com/top-5-reasons-we-love-vanilla-releases). The announcement of a city release is usually done one week before the release. In this announcement they include whether it is vanilla or regular, the percentage of [FSA properties](https://upland-guide.com/fsa-properties) and the [city tier](https://upland-guide.com/city-tiers-and-vanilla-mode).

In preparation for a new city release, it is important to be prepared. [Understand how the process works](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/new-city-release-process), see more tips on our [YouTube playlist](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL3zT4OlFr_bkh21qfI_A3ab6mcOmCjJrf) dedicated to learning more about new city releases. Here are five things that will help you show up prepared.

- [Have a budget](https://upland-guide.com/)
- [Show up on time with sends](https://upland-guide.com/)
- [Research the city](https://upland-guide.com/)
- [Have a plan](https://upland-guide.com/)
- [Have a plan B](https://upland-guide.com/)

### Have a budget

With so much opportunity and properties to mint in a new city, its easy to get carried away. Whether you are investing outside USD or crypto, or if you are using the UPX you have hand, have a budget. There will always be new cities each of which with infinite opportunities, so pace yourself.

Note: If you signed up for the game with the Upland Guide referral code, you are eligible for some great bonuses when making your first purchase of UPX. [Read more here.](https://upland-guide.com/referral-bonus)

### Show up on time with sends

Make sure that you travel to the city before the release time. Stay tuned for Upland's official announcement when travel routes have been opened. You don't want to show up late, because once the city is released, the most popular neighborhoods are completely sold out within minutes. When determining the best way to travel use the [Upland Guide Discord Server Travel Bot](https://discord.gg/rTcdta6wSt). He will tell you both the fastest and cheapest ways to travel from A to B.

### Research the city

title: Preparing for a New City Release : Upland Guide
text:
Document: Preparing for a New City Release : Upland Guide
Source: https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/new-city-release-strategy/preparing-for-a-new-city

### Research the city

Upland is all about creating a Metaverse that blurs the lines between the virtual and the real world. Just like in the real world, a property in the downtown core and a same sized property in the suburbs are not created equal. You wouldn't buy a piece of land in the real world without research, and we recommend the same in the Metaverse. As a rule of thumb, the high value neighborhoods in the real world also have higher values in the Metaverse. [Collection properties](https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy/collections) almost always have high demand and therefore have a higher resale value.

### Have a plan

Formulate a plan. You should have a [long term strategy](https://upland-guide.com/upland-metaverse-strategy) and work backwards from there to determine what properties you want to invest in this specific city. Everyone's plan is different. Maybe your plan doesn't include you owning properties in this specific city. The Metaverse is ever expanding, and soon it might become overwhelming to focus your time an energy in so many different cities. This is why its so important to have a long term strategy and make a budget.

Secondly, if you will be buying your first properties in the new city release make sure to read the [new city release strategy](https://upland-guide.com/new-city-release), as well as the [best strategies for completing the basic collections](https://upland-guide.com/collections-strategy) - newbie, king of the street, and city pro.

### Have a plan B

If the specific properties you want to mint are likely to be other people's plans as well, its good to have a backup plan. Yes, going to mint the most popular place in the city can get you a big payout, but only one person can mint that property. If someone beats you to it, you will want to have a secondary (and maybe even a plan C). Try to avoid impulse purchases. You may find out that UPX could have been better off saved for a future city release or other opportunity.

Lastly, you will want to avoid these [common mistakes made during new city releases](https://upland-guide.com/top-mistakes-new-city-release).

# Stock Car Pro Series : Upland Guide

**Source:** https://upland-guide.com/upland-partnerships/stock-car-pro-series
Upland's partnership with [Stock Car Pro Series](https://www.stockproseries.com.br/stockcar/proseries) in Brazil is an exciting an innovative partnership that brings racing to the metaverse. A digital twin of the Interlagos race track in Sao Paulo has been constructed in Upland, where players who own Stock Car Pro Series cars will be able to compete in exclusive races for great prizes. Players can also own other types of assets to increase their fan score and earn UPX through creating collections. Learn about all the Stock Car Pro Series assets below as well as other important information around collections. [Click here to learn more about car racing in Upland.](https://upland-guide.com/entertainment/car-racing)

Below are a list of the different Stock Car Series Pro assets

** 
** 

Essential Legits

Essentials are the most common type of Legits. However, even within these Essential Legits, there are different rarity levels making some of them extremely difficult to come by.

These essentials are not only collectibles, but they boost your fan score.  Beyond that, that can be added to collections where you can earn a one time UPX bonus for completing the collection, and gain a fan score multiplier boost.

** 
** 

Memento Pass Legits

Passes are a specific type of Legit that function like a voucher would.  Passes are redeemable for Mementos and Spotlights. [Learn about how to exchange your Pass for Mementos and Spotlights](https://upland-guide.com/frequently-asked-questions/upland-assets/upland-legits/legit-pass-exchange-for-memento-spotlight).

Owning a pass, memento or spotlight is required in order to have the opportunity to purchase a Stock Car Pro Series car.

** 
** 

Memento and Spotlight Legits

Mementos are a type of Legit that commemorates a specific moment or event.  This is done by having the driver's statistics from said race included as part of the Legit. Some types of Mementos can be completely unique with only one of them created.

Mementos and spotlights can also boost your fan score and be included in collections to earn an UPX bonus and boosted fan points multipliers.

These Mementos can be a variety of items such as:

- Outfit Wearables (these can be worn by your [3D Ready Player Me Avatar](https://upland-guide.com/community/3d-avatar-identity/ready-player-me-avatar))

- Helmets

- Driver Caps

- Spotlights

A Spotlight is a special type of Memento in the fact that in addition to it commemorating a specific moment or race, the visual representation of the Legit is not a 2D image, but a video.

** 
** 

Cars

In order to have an opportunity to purchase an official Stock Car Pro Series car, you will have to own either a Stock Car Pro Series pass, memento or spotlight.

These cars will be required for exclusive races where winners are able to win prizes.  (For the 2023 season, MV Motors vehicles can be used to qualify).
